sources.limitations: Reports community concerns and allegations, not adjudicated hydrological or legal findings.

sources.title: Honduras country strategic plan 2023–2027
sources.temporal_coverage: Retain the dated scope of individual claims; no extrapolation to present conditions.
sources.methodology: Substantive publisher summary of approved plan; page records December 2024 revision.
sources.limitations: Priorities and intended outcomes are not delivery or impact evidence.

sources.title: Climate Change Adaptation Strategy of the Republic of Croatia to 2040 with a View to 2070
sources.organization: Croatian Parliament; Government of the Republic of Croatia
sources.temporal_coverage: Government strategy adopted in 2020; reports historical sector impacts and RCP4.5 projections for 2011–2040 and 2041–2070, with an outlook to 2070.
sources.methodology: Government strategy blending climate observations, cited damage estimates, projections and sector assessments.
sources.limitations: Historical estimates cite studies; projections use older models and scenario assumptions.

sources.title: Disaster Risk Assessment for the Republic of Croatia
sources.organization: Government of the Republic of Croatia; Directorate of Civil Protection, Ministry of the Interior
sources.temporal_coverage: National disaster-risk assessment dated March 2024; registered county damages cover 2010–2021 and declared natural disasters 2014–2022.
sources.methodology: Government assessment combines hazard scenarios, county vulnerability indicators, recorded losses and civil-protection readiness measures.
sources.limitations: Loss figures aggregate declared disasters and hazards; they do not attribute damages to climate change.

sources.title: Preliminary Flood Risk Assessment 2024
sources.organization: Hrvatske vode (Croatian Waters), national water-management authority
sources.temporal_coverage: The 2024 preliminary assessment uses information through 2023 to identify potentially significant flood-risk areas for the 2028–2033 basin-plan cycle.
sources.methodology: State water authority summarizes mapped potentially significant flood-risk areas and basin population exposure.
sources.limitations: Potential exposure zones are not climate-attributed losses; mapping and management plans are planned for 2028–2033.

sources.title: OECD Economic Surveys: Croatia 2026
sources.organization: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.temporal_coverage: Economic survey published 30 January 2026; climate event-loss series covers 1980–2023 and includes reported 2024 events and current policy status.
sources.methodology: OECD country survey reviews reported event losses, subnational exposure and adaptation policy.
sources.limitations: The survey cites underlying EEA and EIB material; figures are not independently recalculated here.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Haiti (2025)
sources.organization: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute and Norwegian Institute of International Affairs
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed and projected climate, displacement, food-security, and security evidence available through May 2025.
sources.methodology: A specialist four-page synthesis organizes secondary evidence around livelihood, mobility, armed-actor, and political-economic pathways.
sources.limitations: The fact sheet synthesizes other sources and does not independently identify causal effects; selected local examples are not nationally representative. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Plan National d'Adaptation au Changement Climatique 2022-2030
sources.organization: Government of Haiti and United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
geographic_coverage: Haiti, national and municipal adaptation planning
sources.temporal_coverage: National adaptation priorities for 2022-2030.
sources.methodology: The government plan synthesizes risk and vulnerability evidence, consultations, sector priorities, governance arrangements, costs, and monitoring needs.
sources.limitations: The plan records intended actions and estimated financing needs rather than verified implementation or outcomes. The relevant printed-page-16 passage was inspected through continuous indexed text under the official UNFCCC URL; the full PDF exceeded the review tool's size limit.

sources.title: Climate and Health Vulnerability Assessment: Haiti
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with selected subnational health-risk analysis
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate and health evidence with future risk discussion through mid-century and beyond.
sources.methodology: A desk-based climate-health assessment combines hazard, exposure, disease, health-system, and adaptive-capacity evidence.
sources.limitations: The assessment is not a causal Climate-FCV study; some national hazard counts combine events with different definitions and periods. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Climate Risk and Adaptation Country Profile: Haiti
sources.organization: World Bank Group and Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery
geographic_coverage: Haiti and Caribbean regional projection context
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed changes since 1960 and older projections to 2060 and 2090.
sources.methodology: A country profile synthesizes historical observations, national communications, IPCC AR4-era projections, and sector risk literature.
sources.limitations: The projections are old, partly regional, and based on earlier model generations; they should not substitute for a current high-resolution baseline. The relevant printed-page-4 baseline and future sections were inspected through continuous indexed text under the official World Bank PDF URL; direct PDF access returned HTTP 403. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Haiti Country Strategic Plan (2024-2028)
sources.temporal_coverage: Planned operations for 2024-2028, with context indicators available at approval. The live publisher page records Revision 01 approved in June 2026.
sources.methodology: The strategic plan links humanitarian needs, food systems, resilience, government systems, logistics, and intended portfolio outcomes.
sources.limitations: Outcomes and nexus claims are programme intentions, not independent evidence of effectiveness or peace impacts. The original November 2023 plan date is retained; the live page now includes a June 2026 revision, which does not establish implementation results.

sources.title: Evaluation of Haiti WFP Country Strategic Plan 2018-2022
sources.organization: World Food Programme Office of Evaluation
sources.temporal_coverage: Activities from January 2018 through July 2022; evaluation completed in 2023.
sources.methodology: An Office of Evaluation country-portfolio assessment examined strategic positioning, effectiveness, efficiency, and explanatory factors.
sources.limitations: The evaluation predates the latest violence and assesses WFP rather than national response systems or climate-specific outcomes. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Haiti faces record displacement amid escalating gang violence
geographic_coverage: Haiti, with Port-au-Prince and displacement-site context
sources.temporal_coverage: Displacement and access conditions reported through June 2024.
sources.methodology: A UN country-team article reports figures and findings from IOM and independent UN human-rights experts.
sources.limitations: The page is a current synthesis rather than a primary displacement dataset or representative household study.

sources.title: Haiti Humanitarian Situation Report No. 11: End-of-year Sitrep

sources.title: Persistent insecurity and the effects of Hurricane Melissa maintain food insecurity
sources.temporal_coverage: Retain the dated scope of individual claims; no extrapolation to present conditions.
sources.methodology: Food-security monitoring synthesis; only dated observed-context passages retained.
sources.limitations: Earlier outlook forecasts are not current outcomes.

sources.title: Situation Report on the Crisis in Haiti, July–August 2026
sources.temporal_coverage: Retain the dated scope of individual claims; no extrapolation to present conditions.
sources.methodology: Substantive publisher operational summary for July–August 2026.
sources.limitations: Not a climate-attribution study or representative protection survey.

sources.title: Climate Change and Its Impact on Peace and Security in Southeast Asia
sources.organization: Centre for Non-Traditional Security Studies, S. Rajaratnam School of International Studies, Nanyang Technological University
sources.temporal_coverage: Indonesia passages describe 2015 wildfire, 2019 floods, 2022 flooding, and 2023 extreme cold and drought; regional report published November 2023.
sources.methodology: Independent regional study commissioned with UN Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs support; Indonesia case passages cite agency records and published sources.
sources.limitations: Papua incident counts are historical and citation-based; the report explicitly says weather events did not cause internal conflicts.

sources.title: Social Dimensions of Climate Change in Indonesia: Executive Summary
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank report disclosed in November 2023; discusses expected climate impacts and prospective coal-transition distributional risks.
sources.methodology: Eight-page executive summary of World Bank analysis of climate impacts, vulnerable groups, and local responses.
sources.limitations: Executive summary only; transition effects are prospective, not observed conflict.

sources.title: Climate Risk and Community Resilience in Indonesia
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme Indonesia, UNDP Bangkok Regional Hub, and Coordinating Ministry for Human Development and Cultural Affairs
sources.temporal_coverage: Mixed-methods study published October 2025; the publisher summary does not specify fieldwork dates.
sources.methodology: UNDP publication page describes mixed quantitative analysis and qualitative input from communities, stakeholders, and experts.
sources.limitations: Only the directly opened publisher summary was read; its linked 19.9 MB report PDF exceeded browser extraction limits, so no detailed event or village claims are made.

sources.title: Leveraging Community-Driven Development Platforms for Resilience: Lessons from a Global Knowledge Exchange in Jakarta
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank brief published April 2026; West Java restoration described as beginning about a decade earlier.
sources.methodology: World Bank brief reports field-visit examples and national community-driven climate investment systems discussed at a January 2026 exchange.
sources.limitations: Institutional descriptive brief, not an independent impact evaluation; the West Java restoration location is not named and reported results are not causal estimates.

sources.title: District-level Climate Risk Assessment for India: Mapping Flood and Drought Risks released
sources.organization: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India
sources.temporal_coverage: District risk analysis uses flood and drought hazard records from 1970–2019; summary released December 2024.
sources.methodology: Government release summarizing a district assessment by IIT Mandi, IIT Guwahati and CSTEP.
sources.limitations: Risk bands are comparative; the release summarizes rather than reproduces the underlying report.

sources.title: How Extreme Heat is Impacting India: Assessing District-level Heat Risk
sources.organization: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
sources.temporal_coverage: District heat trends for 1982–2022; socio-economic and health indicators include Census 2011 and NFHS 2019–21.
sources.methodology: CEEW district heat-risk index using 35 hazard, exposure and vulnerability indicators.
sources.limitations: Relative bands, dated indicators; state findings need validation.

sources.title: Mitigating the Urban Heat Island Effect in Indian Cities
sources.organization: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
sources.temporal_coverage: HAP status reported July 2026; Delhi climate vulnerability assessment uses 1991–2020 observations and projections to mid-century.
sources.methodology: Ministry press release summarizing heat-action-plan status and the Delhi SAPCC 2.0 assessment.
sources.limitations: Ministry-reported plan counts and planned measures do not establish effectiveness or completed outcomes.

sources.title: NHRC calls for preventive measures by 11 States to protect vulnerable people from heat waves
sources.organization: National Human Rights Commission of India
sources.temporal_coverage: Heat risks and NCRB death data for 2018–2022; NHRC intervention issued May 2025.
sources.methodology: NHRC press release describing its communication to state governments and cited NCRB figures.
sources.limitations: The reported death count is attributed to NCRB; NHRC's requested measures are not evidence of implementation.

sources.title: Climate and Gender: Association Between Droughts and Intimate Partner Violence in India
sources.organization: American Journal of Epidemiology / National Library of Medicine PubMed Central
sources.temporal_coverage: National Family Health Survey rounds 2015–2016 and 2019–2021; article published November 2023.
sources.methodology: Cross-sectional analysis of 122,696 married women, combining survey IPV reports with precipitation-based and government socioeconomic drought classifications.
sources.limitations: Self-reported and cross-sectional data limit generalizability and causal inference; household income pathway was not tested.

sources.title: Human-induced climate change compounded by socio-economic water stressors increased severity of 5-year drought…
sources.temporal_coverage: 2020/21-Oct 2025; counterfactual pre-industrial climate
sources.methodology: SPEI, rainfall analysis, non-stationary extreme-value methods and vulnerability synthesis
sources.limitations: Rapid attribution analysis; rainfall attribution uncertainty includes no change; some vulnerability statements synthesize secondary sources. (World Weather Attribution)

sources.title: Anthropogenic drought dominates groundwater depletion in Iran
sources.methodology: Groundwater observations, recharge, withdrawal, return flows, precipitation and evaporation
sources.limitations: Historical period; does not measure contemporary FCV outcomes. (Nature)

sources.title: Islamic Republic of Iran Intended Nationally Determined Contribution
sources.organization: National Climate Change Committee of Iran / UNFCCC repository
sources.temporal_coverage: 2015; targets to 2030
sources.methodology: Government policy statements and national projections
sources.limitations: Government-authored; some projection methodology is not stated in the accessible text; original UNFCCC file endpoint was inaccessible during verification. (Asia Pacific Energy Policy)

sources.title: Islamic Republic of Iran country overview
sources.temporal_coverage: Through 2025/26
sources.methodology: Current economic/development assessment
sources.limitations: Economic synthesis rather than causal climate study; conflict-related statements should be attributed to the World Bank. (World Bank)

sources.title: Iran, Islamic Rep. - World Development Indicators
sources.temporal_coverage: Indicator-dependent
sources.methodology: WDI indicator compilation
sources.limitations: Indicators have different reference years and underlying methodologies. (World Bank Open Data)

sources.title: Impact of climate change on water crisis and conflicts: Farmers’ perceptions at the ZayandehRud Basin in Iran
sources.organization: Journal of Hydrology: Regional Studies / Elsevier
sources.temporal_coverage: Study-period meteorology plus farmer survey
sources.methodology: Meteorological records + random survey of 301 farmers
sources.limitations: Open-access 2024 farmer-perception study; local ZayandehRud Basin findings do not establish national or causal conflict effects.

sources.title: UNDP Iran CIWP Factsheet
geographic_coverage: Lake Urmia, Shadegan, Bakhtegan, Parishan, Anzali and participating villages
sources.temporal_coverage: Jun 2020-Dec 2028
sources.methodology: Programme monitoring and self-reported results
sources.limitations: No independent counterfactual; performance figures are programme-reported. (UNDP)

sources.title: Conservation of Iranian Wetlands Project - Phase II (Scale-up)
sources.methodology: Administrative/project monitoring
sources.limitations: Achievement statements are implementing-agency reports, not independent impact evaluation. (UNDP)

sources.title: Terminal Evaluation consultancy notice - Lake Urmia and other wetlands
sources.temporal_coverage: Project component 2021-24
sources.methodology: Procurement notice for terminal evaluation
sources.limitations: Demonstrates commissioning of an evaluation, not its findings; final evaluation report not verified. (UNGM)

sources.title: FAO and Iran launch regional project to strengthen climate-resilient agriculture
sources.temporal_coverage: From 2025
sources.methodology: Programme design/workshop description
sources.limitations: Describes intended activities, not evaluated outcomes; agriculture-water statistic differs from WWA terminology. (FAOHome)

sources.title: Projects - FAO in Iran
sources.temporal_coverage: 2023-28 entries
sources.methodology: Administrative portfolio records
sources.limitations: Budgets and timeframes demonstrate committed/programmed capacity, not effectiveness. (FAOHome)

sources.title: Iran's water policy: Environmental injustice and peripheral marginalisation
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical and contemporary water-transfer policy, as discussed in 2024
sources.methodology: Qualitative content analysis of policy and government documents, campaigns and Persian-, Kurdish- and English-language secondary material.
sources.limitations: Interpretive analysis; documents and reported examples do not quantify causal effects of individual transfers.

sources.title: The politics of drought in the Middle East, case study from Iran
sources.temporal_coverage: Recent drought politics, compared across two provinces in a 2025 study
sources.methodology: Comparative qualitative case analysis of drought politics in Isfahan and Hamedan.
sources.limitations: The author notes limited prior research and calls for further regional and media-perception analysis.

sources.title: Groundwater resources exploitation management in response to water scarcity challenges in Khuzestan Province, Iran
sources.organization: Journal of Groundwater Science and Engineering
sources.temporal_coverage: Groundwater measurements from 2008-2018; article published in 2025
sources.methodology: Groundwater-level and hydrochemical analysis of 204 exploration wells and 70 piezometric wells across 19 aquifers; observed data 2008–2018.
sources.limitations: Well observations cover 2008-2018; findings do not measure current household access or climate attribution.

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contribution, Updated in 2025
sources.temporal_coverage: 2025-2035 implementation period
sources.methodology: Government policy, sectoral planning, institutional arrangements and targets
sources.limitations: Commitments and targets demonstrate intended policy/capacity, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Iraq Economic Monitor: A New Opportunity to Reform
sources.temporal_coverage: Mainly 2021-2024 economics; medium-term climate modeling
sources.methodology: Macroeconomic analysis and special-focus synthesis of CCDR modeling
sources.limitations: Climate economic estimates are modelled scenarios, not observed causal effects. (World Bank)

sources.title: Tigris Adaptation and Healthy River Project - Concept-stage PID
sources.temporal_coverage: Current context through 2026; projections to 2035
sources.methodology: Sector/institutional diagnostic supporting project preparation
sources.limitations: Concept-stage project; proposed financing and activities must not be treated as achieved results.

sources.title: Advocacy Note: Water Scarcity and Climate Risks in Iraq
sources.methodology: Synthesis of water, displacement and humanitarian indicators
sources.limitations: Advocacy document rather than independent causal study; some underlying datasets are summarized rather than reproduced. (The United Nations in Iraq)

sources.title: Localised interlinkages between climate, peace, and security in Iraq
geographic_coverage: National synthesis plus selected local cases
sources.temporal_coverage: Aug 2023-May 2024
sources.methodology: 15 semi-structured interviews, 46 internal reports/case studies, media/analytical sources; UN Climate Security Mechanism framework
sources.limitations: Qualitative and purposive; selected cases explicitly not exhaustive; some supporting sources are secondary.

sources.title: Climate change effects on conflict dynamics in Iraq: Makhmur, Tal Afar and Al-Rifai
sources.temporal_coverage: Field evidence mainly 2022-2023
sources.methodology: 20 in-depth interviews and 10 focus groups with 124 participants, plus contextual analysis
sources.limitations: Three purposively selected districts; women underrepresented in IDIs; perception evidence cannot establish national causality. (Berghof Foundation)

sources.title: Local Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Kurdistan Region - Iraq
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical baseline and future scenarios; plan current from 2024
sources.methodology: Participatory technical working group, climate vulnerability assessment, sector adaptation planning
sources.limitations: KRI-specific; proposed interventions/MRL are planned capacity rather than demonstrated outcomes.

sources.title: Independent Country Programme Evaluation: Iraq
geographic_coverage: North, central and south; national programme
sources.temporal_coverage: UNDP programme Jan 2020-Sep 2023
sources.methodology: UNEG-standard evaluation; triangulation; 215 stakeholder interviews; field visits; GIS analysis
sources.limitations: Security/visa constraints cancelled planned visits to Kirkuk, Sulaymaniyah and Najaf; some projects unfinished.

sources.title: Evaluation of Iraq WFP Country Strategic Plan 2020-2024
sources.temporal_coverage: Activities 2017-Oct 2023
sources.methodology: Independent strategic/portfolio evaluation of relevance, effectiveness, efficiency and performance
sources.limitations: Full report download was not accessible through the browsing environment; official page conclusions were accessible. Page displays “3 May 2023” despite evaluation coverage extending to Oct 2023, so publication-date metadata requires independent confirmation. (World Food Programme)

sources.title: GCF approves USD 39 million for SRVALI project
sources.organization: FAO / GCF / United Nations in Iraq
sources.temporal_coverage: Planned six-year implementation
sources.methodology: Programme design, financing and intended beneficiary/outcome statements
sources.limitations: Announcement only; beneficiary numbers and expected effects are targets, not evaluated performance. (The United Nations in Iraq)

sources.title: The Impact of Conflict, Climate and the Economy on Agriculture in Districts of Return in Iraq
sources.organization: International Organization for Migration and Social Inquiry
geographic_coverage: 14 districts of return across Anbar, Diyala, Kirkuk, Ninewa and Salah al-Din
sources.temporal_coverage: Household data collected March-April 2022; report published 2024
sources.methodology: Survey of 2,260 returnees in 14 districts, collected March-April 2022.
sources.limitations: Self-reported and limited to sampled return districts.

sources.title: Cracked Earth, shrinking harvest: Drought impact on displaced and returnee Iraqis
sources.temporal_coverage: Displacement and returnee conditions, with 2023-2024 drought indicators
sources.methodology: Publisher page summarizes drought and displacement survey findings in named governorates.
sources.limitations: Full report methods were unavailable in the inspected excerpt.

sources.title: Applying causality to environmental security in Iraq
sources.temporal_coverage: Subdistrict observations from January 2020 to January 2022
sources.methodology: Observational subdistrict analysis using structural equation modeling and causal-inference methods with conflict and environmental indicators.
sources.limitations: Authors note omitted social and political variables, limited temporal coverage and mismatches between tribal and administrative boundaries.

sources.title: Context and Conflict Analysis: Sustainable and Resilient Future Ninewa Project
sources.organization: World Vision International / Australian NGO Cooperation Program
sources.temporal_coverage: Participatory assessment conducted February 2026
sources.methodology: Participatory qualitative assessment using eight focus groups and ten key-informant interviews across four Ninewa areas.
sources.limitations: Purposive qualitative sample is not statistically representative; findings describe participants' reported conditions and views.

sources.title: Climate Change Risk and Vulnerability Assessment: Trelawny
sources.organization: UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) and UNDP Jamaica, with the Green Climate Fund and Trelawny Municipal Corporation
sources.temporal_coverage: Report dated 10 August 2025; community risk and adaptive-capacity assessment with historical hazard records and projections through 2059.
sources.methodology: Parish CRVA combines hazard, exposure, sensitivity and adaptive-capacity indices, with stakeholder validation.
sources.limitations: The report notes gaps in localized data and long-term projections; recommendations are not measured outcomes.

sources.title: Climate Change Risk and Vulnerability Assessment: Westmoreland
sources.organization: UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) and UNDP Jamaica, with the Green Climate Fund and Westmoreland Municipal Corporation
sources.temporal_coverage: Report dated 10 August 2025; historical hazard records and downscaled projections for 2030–2039, 2040–2049 and 2050–2059.
sources.methodology: Parish CRVA combines hazard, exposure, sensitivity and adaptive-capacity indices, with stakeholder validation.
sources.limitations: The report notes western-region projection gaps; options are proposals.

sources.title: Jamaica Systematic Country Diagnostic: Boosting Recovery and Sustainable Economic Growth
sources.temporal_coverage: Country diagnostic published in 2022, drawing on historical disaster, household, labor-market and social evidence available to the assessment.
sources.methodology: Country diagnostic synthesizes Jamaican economic, social, household and climate-risk evidence.
sources.limitations: Evidence largely predates 2022; no climate-caused violence finding.

sources.title: Jamaica's Progress Towards Implementation of Key Climate Change Adaptation Actions and Plans
sources.temporal_coverage: Performance audit of climate-adaptation planning and implementation during 2018/19–2024/25; selected project statuses are dated October 2025 or January 2026.
sources.methodology: Independent performance audit reviewed ministry records, project status, coordination, stakeholder engagement and monitoring.
sources.limitations: Findings describe the audit period and stated cut-off dates, not implementation status after January 2026.

sources.title: LG-ACT Project Brief
sources.organization: Ministry of Local Government and Community Development, Government of Jamaica
geographic_coverage: urban communities served by municipal water systems
sources.temporal_coverage: Undated government project brief; describes planned activities over a stated 27-month project period.
sources.methodology: Government project brief describes objectives, components and expected outcomes.
sources.limitations: The page gives no publication date or current status; expected outcomes do not demonstrate completed work.

sources.title: Parish Safety and Security Mechanism
sources.organization: Ministry of Local Government and Community Development, Government of Jamaica
sources.temporal_coverage: Undated government description of the parish-level safety and security mechanism.
sources.methodology: Ministry page describes committee mandates, participation and coordination functions.
sources.limitations: The page is undated and documents institutional design, not current operation or outcomes.

sources.title: Approach Paper: Jamaica Country Program Evaluation, Fiscal Years 2014–25
sources.organization: World Bank Group, Independent Evaluation Group
sources.temporal_coverage: December 2025 evaluation approach-paper context; not completed evaluation results.
sources.methodology: Evaluation approach paper synthesizing country context.
sources.limitations: Contextual diagnosis, not a completed impact evaluation or local causal estimate.

sources.title: Planning for Secure Water Futures in Contexts of Drought and Displacement: Evidence from Mafraq, Jordan
sources.organization: UN-Habitat Jordan and International Institute for Environment and Development
geographic_coverage: Dahiyyat Al-Malik Abdullah neighborhood, Mafraq City
sources.temporal_coverage: Neighborhood fieldwork and water assessment reported in 2026; selected historical water, population and satellite indicators date to 2014–2025.
sources.methodology: Mixed methods: desk review, GIS, 70-household survey, fieldwork and stakeholder workshops.
sources.limitations: Mafraq case; local survey is not national; over-abstraction is also a water deficit driver.

sources.title: Integrating Climate Security into Policies: Roadmap for Jordan
sources.temporal_coverage: Qualitative risk pathways and institutional assessment, 2023; climate projections discussed in the report extend through 2100.
sources.methodology: Year-long desk research, interviews, consultations and government validation.
sources.limitations: Qualitative pathways synthesize secondary research; no causal impact evaluation.

sources.title: Vulnerability Assessment of the Water Sector to Climate Change in Jordan
sources.organization: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia
sources.temporal_coverage: Reference climate period 1995–2014; near-term 2021–2040 and mid-term 2041–2060 projections.
sources.methodology: RICCAR geospatial water-sector assessment combines exposure, sensitivity and adaptive-capacity indicators with six downscaled climate models.
sources.limitations: National assessment; some indicators were omitted where comparable data were unavailable; projections are model outputs, not observations.

sources.title: Jordan Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Country conditions and regional shocks through 2022; selected climate projections extend to 2040.
sources.methodology: World Bank country climate and development analysis; relevant executive-summary passages inspected.
sources.limitations: National-level findings; inspected executive-summary projection does not specify its climate scenario.

sources.title: Completion of ICRC Water Program: Host Communities and Syrian Refugees in Jordan 2014–2023
sources.organization: International Committee of the Red Cross
sources.temporal_coverage: ICRC infrastructure program 2014–2022; evaluation findings through 2022 and capacity-building actions in 2023.
sources.methodology: Report compiles works and external evaluation through 2022.
sources.limitations: Efficiency later declined amid maintenance gaps.

sources.title: Republic of Kazakhstan: Climate Adaptation Options and Opportunities in the Agriculture Sector
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed climate and agricultural indicators to 2024; historical metering pilot and adaptation plans; future drought risks with unspecified warming scenarios.
sources.methodology: Rapid literature review and interviews with selected agriculture producers and stakeholders.
sources.limitations: National technical synthesis; some findings are report-era plans.

sources.title: Water-Related Climate Hazards and Adaptation Measures in Kazakhstan: Data and Literature Analysis
sources.organization: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH; EarthYield Advisories GbR
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical hazard baseline and 2021 impacts; modeled drought, flood and heatwave probabilities through 2080 or later under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5.
sources.methodology: Literature review, expert exchange and grid-based hazard modeling under three SSP scenarios.
sources.limitations: Hydrological drought and general water depletion were omitted for data gaps; some local findings are secondary citations.

sources.title: The Impact of Climate Change on the Dynamics of Conflicts in the Transboundary River Basins of Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan
sources.temporal_coverage: Field research September-November 2021; includes historical 2012-2013 water disputes and reported 2021 conditions.
sources.methodology: Desk review, interviews, focus groups.
sources.limitations: Qualitative; outcomes uncertain.

sources.title: A New Growth Model for Building a Secure Middle Class: Kazakhstan Systematic Country Diagnostic
sources.temporal_coverage: Systematic country diagnostic published 2018; climate-susceptibility mapping uses 2014 data.
sources.methodology: Country diagnostic drawing on administrative, household-survey and sector evidence.
sources.limitations: Historic diagnosis; cited climate-susceptibility map reflects 2014 conditions.

sources.title: Climate Resilient Water Resources Development
sources.temporal_coverage: Project duration 26 September 2025 to 31 December 2027; page reports ongoing implementation.
sources.methodology: Official project page describes objectives, partners, duration and status.
sources.limitations: Page describes intended activities, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Kenya's Adaptation Communication to the UNFCCC
sources.temporal_coverage: Climate exposure, drought impacts and adaptation actions reported in the 2024 communication
sources.methodology: Government communication synthesizing climate, sector and stakeholder evidence and consultations.
sources.limitations: Program-effectiveness findings draw on consultations, not controlled evaluation.

sources.title: Kenya's Second Nationally Determined Contribution, 2031-2035
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed climate, disaster impacts, and projections through 2035 reported in 2025
sources.methodology: National contribution summarizes trends, projections, disaster impacts and adaptation priorities.
sources.limitations: Impacts cite other sources; 2031-2035 priorities are plans, not evaluated results.

sources.title: Turkana County Participatory Climate Risk Vulnerability Assessment Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Participatory assessment of historical/current conditions and RCP4.5/RCP8.5 projections through 2100
sources.methodology: Participatory assessment with surveys, KIIs and FGDs across 30 wards.
sources.limitations: Perception-based; proposed actions are not evaluated.

sources.title: Turbulent waters, troubled shores: the twin threats of climate change and conflict on vulnerable communities around Lake Turkana
sources.temporal_coverage: Conflict analysis published 2026; report covers Lake Turkana Basin communities
sources.methodology: International Alert conflict analysis commissioned by WFP; publisher page summarizes climate, environmental, economic and social drivers.
sources.limitations: Only substantive publisher-page summary was inspected; full report PDF was not accessible in this session.

sources.title: Facing old and new risks in arid environments: The case of pastoral communities in Northern Kenya
sources.temporal_coverage: Structured review of longstanding and emerging risks, drawing on literature available through 2023
sources.methodology: Structured literature review spanning pastoralism, climate security, conflict, conservation and large energy projects.
sources.limitations: Synthesis of literature rather than new household fieldwork; authors note contested climate-conflict mechanisms.

sources.title: Climate governance in Kenya
sources.temporal_coverage: Self-reported programming and policy processes, including Samburu work during 2018-2022
sources.methodology: Organization's public description of its county-level climate governance and peacebuilding work.
sources.limitations: Self-reported program description without independent outcome evaluation on the inspected page.

sources.title: Local forms of resilience in pastoral areas: a scoping study in Northern Kenya - Final Report
sources.organization: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research
sources.temporal_coverage: Scoping study of local resilience in northern pastoral areas, published 2023
sources.methodology: Scoping study; publisher summary describes northern Kenya local resilience actors and program implications.
sources.limitations: Only the publisher's report description was inspected; detailed methods and findings were not available in the excerpt.

sources.title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.organization: State Committee for Ecology and Climate of the Kyrgyz Republic
sources.temporal_coverage: Updated NDC published in 2021, with commitments and measures through 2030.
sources.methodology: Prepared through an inter-agency process with experts, scientists, civil society, the private sector, and youth.
sources.limitations: National policy assessment; proposed adaptation measures are not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Kyrgyz Republic Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank CCDR summary page presenting current risks and projections through mid-century.
sources.methodology: Official World Bank summary of the 2025 CCDR risk, economic-impact, and policy findings.
sources.limitations: The complete report PDF exceeded the browser size limit; the official summary does not specify all model scenarios.

sources.title: World Bank Supports the Kyrgyz Republic in Sustainable Landscape Management and Climate Mitigation and Adaptation
sources.temporal_coverage: Press release dated February 2024; project implementation planned through 2029.
sources.methodology: Official World Bank release describing an approved resilient-landscape project and intended coverage and activities.
sources.limitations: Beneficiary figures and activities are project plans, not completed results.

sources.title: What is the Impact of Climate on Local Communities in the Isfara River Catchment?
sources.organization: Mountain Societies Research Institute, University of Central Asia
sources.temporal_coverage: Field research February-November 2019; runoff and climate series include historical and 1999-2018 observations
sources.methodology: Combines hydrology, satellite vegetation and six-village interviews.
sources.limitations: Perceptions differ from runoff; data gaps remain.

sources.title: The impact of climate change on the dynamics of conflicts in the transboundary river basins of Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan
sources.temporal_coverage: Field and analytical process September-November 2021; publication copyright 2021 and portal dated January 2022
sources.methodology: Desk review plus interviews and focus groups in three-country border areas.
sources.limitations: Regional qualitative analysis; some evidence is expert-reported.

sources.title: Every drop counts: FAO support for the implementation of an electronic irrigation water monitoring system in Kyrgyzstan
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
geographic_coverage: pilot areas in Naryn and Batken
sources.temporal_coverage: Project and local water-management examples reported in 2024
sources.methodology: FAO feature story describes project implementation and farmer/community experiences.
sources.limitations: Agency feature story; reported conflict reduction and local benefits are not accompanied by an independent impact evaluation.

sources.title: Consultations to analyse vulnerabilities to climate change impacts and identify adaptation priorities with representatives of Osh, Jalal-Abad and Batken provinces
sources.temporal_coverage: Provincial adaptation consultations held in February 2023; release published February 2024
sources.methodology: UNDP account of consultations with provincial government and sector representatives as part of a climate risk and vulnerability assessment.
sources.limitations: Press release records participant views and planning status, not a completed vulnerability assessment or adaptation outcomes.

sources.title: Acting on Climate Change is Key for Cambodia to Achieve its Development Goals
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical hazard impacts and Cambodia CCDR projections summarized in the 2023 release.
sources.methodology: World Bank release summarizing selected Cambodia CCDR findings and historical event estimates.
sources.limitations: Headline figures are reported without full event-attribution or model-method detail on this page.

sources.title: Cambodia’s NDC 3.0
sources.organization: Government of Cambodia, Ministry of Environment
sources.temporal_coverage: National vulnerability evidence and adaptation measures in the 2025 NDC 3.0, including targets through 2035.
sources.methodology: Government submission synthesizing cited climate-risk, poverty, sector, and policy sources.
sources.limitations: Some hazard estimates are attributed to cited secondary studies; planned measures and targets are not completed outcomes.

sources.title: Climate Change and Migration Patterns: Findings at the Commune Level in Rural Provinces of Cambodia
geographic_coverage: Kbal Romeas Commune, Stung Treng Province
sources.temporal_coverage: Household survey and local interviews in July 2023; recalled hazard and migration patterns over the preceding decade.
sources.methodology: Mixed-method study using surveys of 240 households with migrants, 15 key-informant interviews and local stakeholder consultations across three communes.
sources.limitations: Cross-sectional migrant-household sample; reported pathways are locally grounded, not causal estimates or nationally representative.

sources.title: Climate rationale for water, sanitation and hygiene services in Cambodia
sources.organization: UNICEF Cambodia and Stockholm International Water Institute
geographic_coverage: rural and urban WASH service areas
sources.temporal_coverage: August 2024 publication; climate-risk mapping includes historical observations, 2019 census service data and projections.
sources.methodology: Climate-risk analysis combines available datasets, GIS mapping and multi-stakeholder consultation across WASH subsectors.
sources.limitations: National-sector risk screening uses uneven underlying data; proposed actions are not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Disorientations: The Political Ecology of ‘Displacing’ Floating Communities from Cambodia's Tonle Sap Lake
sources.temporal_coverage: Fieldwork in displaced and non-displaced communities from 2018 through 2023; analysis of relocation and hydrological change.
sources.methodology: Ethnographic study using interviews, community workshops and participatory mapping with displaced and non-displaced Tonle Sap communities.
sources.limitations: Qualitative case study; it does not quantify population-wide effects or isolate climate from dams and other development drivers.

sources.title: The role of perceived peer effect in shaping farmers’ adaptive behaviors in Cambodia
geographic_coverage: Eight villages in the Tonle Sap Lake area near Achang irrigation dam
sources.temporal_coverage: Household and network data collected in 2023; publication June 2026.
sources.methodology: Mixed-method household survey, interviews and field observations analyzed with social-influence models.
sources.limitations: Eight-village sample; network measures are self-reported and authors could not identify causal diffusion dynamics.

sources.title: US$20m climate adaptation support for Kiribati's outer islands
sources.temporal_coverage: 2022 approval and earlier adaptation outputs
sources.methodology: Project announcement with outer-island diagnosis.
sources.limitations: Project design and intended benefits; implementation and outcomes are not established.

sources.title: Kiribati: A nation on the frontline of climate change
sources.temporal_coverage: Undated climate and observation-capacity synopsis
sources.methodology: SOFF programme feature; national qualitative diagnosis.
sources.limitations: Publisher summary, not the complete underlying study or an independent causal evaluation.

sources.title: Kiribati Natural Disasters and Climate Change Survey Report 2023–2024
sources.organization: Kiribati National Statistics Office and Pacific Community
sources.temporal_coverage: Household impacts during 2023–2024; HIES survey period.
sources.methodology: Natural-disaster module in the 2023–2024 Household Income and Expenditure Survey; 1,208 households interviewed, weighted for population estimates.
sources.limitations: PDF is marked DRAFT. Results have sampling uncertainty, no cross-variable statistical correlations, and an internal 25%/26% affected-population discrepancy; affected-household results are used instead.

sources.title: Third National Communication of the Republic of Kiribati to the UNFCCC
sources.organization: Government of the Republic of Kiribati, Ministry of Environment, Lands and Agricultural Development
sources.temporal_coverage: National circumstances and impacts through the report's March 2025 version; some drought history is retrospective.

sources.title: St. Kitts and Nevis Third National Communication to the UNFCCC

sources.title: Report of the vulnerability and capacity assessments in coastal and fishing communities in Saint Kitts and Nevis

sources.title: Final Workshops Held for GCF Readiness 4 Project in St. Kitts and Nevis

sources.limitations: Official project summary, not an independent evaluation of whether systems are operational or outcomes sustained.

sources.title: WSD Advances Water Security and Reliability Initiatives Amid Climate Change Challenges
sources.organization: Ministry of Public Infrastructure, Energy, and Utilities, Government of St. Kitts and Nevis

sources.limitations: Government report of service and project status; future supply volumes are projections, not verified delivery outcomes.

sources.title: Lao PDR’s 2020 Updated and Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution

sources.title: Global Status of Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems 2024: Lao PDR country perspective

sources.title: FAO and Partners Conclude Anticipatory Action Project in Lao People's Democratic Republic, Strengthening Flood Resilience

sources.temporal_coverage: 2024-2035 strategy; projection to 2040
sources.methodology: Project design, water-sector diagnostic and reform measures

sources.methodology: Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment; ground and remote information assembled with government, UN and partners

sources.title: *Lebanon Emergency Assistance Project: Frequently Asked Questions* (World Bank)

sources.methodology: Financing and implementation design for recovery of lifeline infrastructure
sources.limitations: Programme architecture and financing are inputs/intended mechanisms, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.methodology: 5,002 interviews; weighted sample; 4,670 face-to-face and 332 remote in Bint Jbeil/Marjeyoun
sources.limitations: Self-reported experiences and perceptions; no meteorological attribution and no causal identification of climate effects on tension. Southern access constraints affected mode of interview.

sources.title: *Water as a Tool for Defusing Socio-Political Tension - Executive Summary*
sources.organization: UNICEF Lebanon; AUB-IFI; Search for Common Ground
geographic_coverage: Lebanon; local hotspot evidence including North Lebanon
sources.temporal_coverage: Published 2022
sources.methodology: Mapping combining socioeconomic, water/environmental and socio-political indicators; programme experience
sources.limitations: Six-page executive summary, not an independent impact evaluation; local project observations cannot establish national causality.

sources.title: *Water Scarcity and Social Tensions in Lebanon: Lessons from the Bcharreh-Denniyeh Case*
sources.organization: ALEF - act for human rights, with Oxfam/SHiFT/Right to Play
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical dispute through 2025
sources.methodology: Secondary-source policy synthesis and case analysis
sources.limitations: Advocacy/policy source; many factual claims derive from secondary journalism or other reports. Its claim that the case previews a national trend is not adopted here.

sources.title: *Conflict Sensitivity Guidance for the Food Security and Agriculture sector (FSAS) in Lebanon*
sources.organization: International Alert with FSA Core Group; UNDP-supported
sources.temporal_coverage: 2024-2025 context
sources.methodology: Workshop, semi-structured interviews, validation meeting and sector best practice
sources.limitations: Guidance/programme theory rather than evaluation; some contextual statistics are reproduced from IPC and perception sources.

sources.title: *Evaluation of Lebanon Host Communities Support Project (2019-2022)*
sources.temporal_coverage: Programme 2019-2022; evaluation Apr-Oct 2023
sources.methodology: OECD-DAC, theory-based evaluation; interviews, 118 FGD participants including 57 women, site observation and document review, triangulation
sources.limitations: Not climate-specific; predates later conflict and 2025 climate policies. Evaluators identify important M&E weaknesses limiting outcome attribution.

sources.title: From Crisis to Recovery: Local Authorities Confronting Post-War Realities in Lebanon: Rapid Impact Assessment
geographic_coverage: 135 surveyed affected areas in 19 districts and eight governorates
sources.temporal_coverage: Hostilities October 2023–November 2024; municipality survey 5–15 December 2024; publication January 2025.
sources.methodology: Municipal self-survey of 135 affected areas, coordinated with governorate disaster-risk units, plus four local deep dives, displacement records and a November 2024 perceptions survey.
sources.limitations: About 34% of affected areas responded; 62 mostly southern-border areas were hard to reach. Estimates are preliminary and unvalidated; some damage may predate September 2024.

sources.title: The Socioeconomic Impacts of the 2024 War on Lebanon

sources.temporal_coverage: 2024 war impacts; field data collected December 2024–February 2025; publication July 2025.
sources.methodology: Joint UN analysis of field surveys, satellite damage data and sector studies.
sources.limitations: Desk review supplements primary data; projection scenario is unspecified.

sources.title: FAO and Ministry of Agriculture Launch the Lebanon Agricultural Damage and Loss Assessment Report
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), Ministry of Agriculture and National Council for Scientific Research-Lebanon

sources.methodology: Official FAO launch summary of a DIEM-Impact agricultural damage-and-loss assessment conducted with the Ministry of Agriculture and CNRS-L.
sources.limitations: Only the official launch summary was inspected; the linked full report was inaccessible, so no unreported tables or localities are asserted.

sources.title: Liberia Country Climate and Development Report

sources.temporal_coverage: Recent programme activity through 2026

geographic_coverage: National with Alkufra and other operational locations
sources.temporal_coverage: Through Oct 2025

sources.temporal_coverage: Current macro/institutional context

sources.organization: Morocco Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development, Department of Sustainable Development
sources.temporal_coverage: National plan for 2022-2030; combines observed climate trends, sector risk analysis and proposed adaptation measures.
sources.methodology: Plan assesses national and sector vulnerability and prioritizes adaptation actions.
sources.limitations: French text was translated for paraphrase; listed measures are proposals.

sources.title: Water Scarcity in Morocco: Analysis of Key Water Challenges
sources.temporal_coverage: National model uses a 2016 baseline and medium- to long-run water-supply and crop-yield scenarios.
sources.methodology: GTAP-BIO-W comparative-static model simulates national water and crop-yield shocks.
sources.limitations: Results are modeled, not observed, and provide no named local estimates.

sources.title: Morocco 2000003887: PADERMO Supervision Report February 2026
sources.temporal_coverage: Report dated 5 February 2026 on a supervision mission held 16-29 November 2025; implementation indicators generally reflect 31 October 2025.
sources.methodology: Joint 11-day supervision mission visited project sites and reviewed implementation, targeting and climate risks.
sources.limitations: French-language mission report; status reflects late 2025, not current delivery.

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0 of the Republic of Moldova
sources.organization: Government of the Republic of Moldova; submitted to the UNFCCC
sources.temporal_coverage: Submitted 6 May 2025; subnational risk index cited is from 2023, with historical impacts and a non-time-specific rainfall outlook.
sources.methodology: Government NDC synthesizes climate, social-risk and adaptation evidence.
sources.limitations: Index does not name 28 districts or assess conflict.

sources.title: Opportunities and Challenges of Climate Adaptation Policies, Republic of Moldova
sources.temporal_coverage: Published February 2024; analysis based on information available through 28 November 2023 and disaster impacts over the preceding three decades.
sources.methodology: IMF analysis uses ND-GAIN indicators, disaster records and macroeconomic modelling.
sources.limitations: National and comparative estimates; modelled benefits are not observed project outcomes.

sources.title: Moldova: Drought Portal country profile
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.temporal_coverage: Undated profile; statistics and referenced plans cover different years, including drought records through 2022 and institutional sources from 2019-2024.
sources.methodology: FAO country profile compiles drought, livelihood, infrastructure and institutional indicators from listed sources.
sources.limitations: The page does not date the profile or establish that older plans and arrangements remain operational.

sources.title: Hydro-infrastructure rehabilitation to mitigate vulnerability to climate-driven extreme events in the Republic of Moldova
sources.temporal_coverage: Project listed as active for 2024-2027; accomplishments and budget delivery are reported through 2025, with later work ongoing or planned.
sources.methodology: UNDP project page describes design, pilot coverage, reported outputs and training.
sources.limitations: Project outputs and training do not establish reduced flood losses or durable watershed-wide resilience.

sources.title: Results of the Post-Disaster Needs Assessment Following the Dniester River Pollution Crisis Presented to the Public
sources.organization: National Crisis Management Centre, Government of the Republic of Moldova
sources.temporal_coverage: Government summary of the spring 2026 pollution crisis and the PDNA presented on 16 October 2026; full report was not yet posted on the page.
sources.methodology: Government summary of a PDNA conducted with UN, EU and World Bank methodology and sector teams.
sources.limitations: Only the official web summary was accessible; proposed recovery actions were still being finalized.

sources.title: Madagascar Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Climate-development diagnostics and recent Grand Sud impacts reported in 2024
sources.methodology: Country diagnostic combining climate risks, development analysis and regional vulnerability discussion.
sources.limitations: Grand Sud impacts include pandemic, market, poverty and institutional factors; climate's causal contribution to hunger or violence is not isolated.

sources.title: Madagascar Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
sources.temporal_coverage: Recent disaster and displacement information and climate projections summarized in the 2026 NDC
sources.methodology: National contribution synthesizes climate, vulnerability and disaster information from cited studies.
sources.limitations: French document; passages summarize cited figures, not a harmonized impact series.

sources.title: Madagascar and the Social Impacts of Drought
sources.organization: World Bank, Social Sustainability and Inclusion Global Practice
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank monitoring of the 2018-2022 drought and recovery period in southern Madagascar.
sources.methodology: Blog summarizes four-monthly monitoring of a representative 480-person panel during 2020-2022.
sources.limitations: Blog summary; respondent perceptions, not recorded incidence or causal effects.

sources.title: Greening the Great South of Madagascar: How Communities Are Fighting Drought and Restoring Hope
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank feature on Great South climate and livelihood conditions and MIONJO results, published 2 June 2025.
sources.methodology: World Bank project feature with local examples, project-reported restoration outputs and staff commentary.
sources.limitations: Feature story, not a full risk assessment or independent impact evaluation; project outputs and examples are agency-reported.

sources.title: Madagascar Advocacy Note for Humanitarian Response
sources.temporal_coverage: Humanitarian crisis overview and response planning in the October 2025 advocacy note, including shocks from late 2024 through 2025.
sources.methodology: Humanitarian Country Team advocacy note consolidating IPC, sector and partner situation information and response requirements.
sources.limitations: Advocacy and needs-planning document; projections to January 2026 have since elapsed and were not outcome-verified here.

sources.title: Speed Saves Lives: What Cyclone Gezani Reveals about the Value of Rapid and Flexible Financing for Children
sources.temporal_coverage: UNICEF report on Cyclone Gezani's 10 February 2026 impacts and response, published 19 June 2026.
sources.methodology: UNICEF retrospective account of reported government and partner impacts and response outputs.
sources.limitations: Agency-reported figures; not independently audited here.

sources.title: Key Highlights: Maldives Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank CCDR highlights updated 2024; includes projections to mid-century and 2100.
sources.methodology: Official World Bank summary of the Maldives CCDR findings and recommendations.
sources.limitations: The linked full CCDR PDF returned 403; claims are limited to passages on the official highlights page.

sources.title: Maldives Country Environmental Analysis: Towards a More Sustainable and Resilient Blue Economy
sources.temporal_coverage: Country Environmental Analysis published in 2024; includes current environmental analysis and prospective policy recommendations.
sources.methodology: Official World Bank page presenting CEA findings and recommendations on natural resource management and the blue economy.
sources.limitations: The linked full PDF could not be retrieved by the browser; only the substantive official publisher summary was used.

sources.title: Maldives' Third Nationally Determined Contribution: National Climate Action Plan Towards Resilience and Low-Carbon Development
sources.organization: Ministry of Tourism and Environment, Government of Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: NDC3 submitted in February 2025; national climate assessment and action planning to 2035.
sources.methodology: Government NDC presenting climate context, consultation, adaptation priorities, and planned mitigation and resilience actions.
sources.limitations: The NDC is a policy submission, not an evaluation of outcomes; the inspected passages identify risks but do not provide island-level estimates.

sources.title: Common Country Analysis 2024
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator Office, Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: UN Country Analysis 2024, including climate projections, 2024 social context and historical island water shortages.
sources.methodology: UNCT input, risk-matrix survey, desk review and statistics.
sources.limitations: Geographic and demographic data gaps; evidence dates vary.

sources.title: Common Country Analysis Maldives (January 2021)
sources.temporal_coverage: UN CCA prepared/endorsed in January 2021; cited climate, water and gender evidence includes earlier years.
sources.methodology: UN system collective country assessment drawing on national and UN data, sector reports and cited studies.
sources.limitations: Historical national-level analysis; the conditional food-scarcity and sexual-exploitation risk is not an incident estimate.

sources.title: Strengthening National and Subnational Capacity for Sustainable Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation and Mitigation in Maldives
sources.organization: United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP)
sources.temporal_coverage: Climate hazard and sector exposure projections through 2060, with current risk-planning recommendations.
sources.methodology: ESCAP overlays downscaled projections with population, agriculture, infrastructure and land-use layers.
sources.limitations: Model, population, land-use and infrastructure data have stated gaps.

sources.title: Disaster Statistics of Maldives 2024
sources.organization: National Disaster Management Authority, Government of Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: NDMA incident collection from December 2023 through December 2024.
sources.methodology: NDMA incident reports and recorded government relief/recovery assistance, disaggregated by hazard, atoll and island.
sources.limitations: Report notes uneven remote-island reporting, no consistent affected-person disaggregation, and no systematic aid-effectiveness monitoring.

sources.title: Enhancing Climate Resilience and Food Security Project (ECRFS Project)
sources.organization: Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Government of Maldives
sources.temporal_coverage: Ongoing project, 2025-2030; page reports activities through October 2026.
sources.methodology: Government project page summarizing design, site locations and project-reported implementation updates.
sources.limitations: Activities and outputs are project-reported; project objectives and expected outcomes are not evaluated impacts.

sources.title: CRM in Maldives: Strengthening synergies and alignment of DRR and climate action
sources.organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR)
sources.temporal_coverage: Technical assistance and capacity development completed during 2022-2024; case study published September 2025.
sources.methodology: UNDRR case study summarizing government and partner technical-assistance activities and reported strategy outputs.
sources.limitations: Institutional case study, not an independent evaluation of strategy implementation or subnational outcomes.

sources.title: Actualización de la Contribución Determinada a nivel Nacional 3.0 de México
sources.organization: Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT), Government of Mexico; submitted to UNFCCC
sources.temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 published in 2025; reports current and historical conditions and sets proposed actions through 2035.
sources.methodology: Government NDC synthesizes national diagnostics and proposed climate measures.
sources.limitations: Costa Chica annex is regional; proposed measures are not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Panorama nacional de datos, tendencias y respuestas políticas al nexo entre migración, medio ambiente y cambio climático (MMACC) en México
sources.temporal_coverage: Published 2025; reviews migration, disaster and climate evidence, including relocations through November 2024 and earlier cases.
sources.methodology: IOM synthesis of scientific literature, policy, programmes, laws and documented mobility cases.
sources.limitations: Evidence is stronger in central-southern Mexico; the report notes research gaps in the north.

sources.title: Mexico Poverty and Equity Assessment
sources.temporal_coverage: Published 2024; climate exposure estimates mainly use 2020 population and poverty-vulnerability estimates use data through 2022.
sources.methodology: World Bank analysis combines census, household-survey, hazard-exposure and poverty-risk measures.
sources.limitations: State vulnerability rates are estimates cited from a separate ENIGH-based model, not conflict measures.

sources.title: Climate Change and Migration from Central America: Insights from Migrants in Mexico
sources.organization: University of California, Berkeley School of Law Human Rights Clinic, in partnership with the Institute for Women in Migration (IMUMI)
sources.temporal_coverage: Published April 2026; survey and interviews concern migrants in Mexico during July-December 2024.
sources.methodology: Report combines a 2024 survey of 87 migrants in transit, key-informant interviews and desk research.
sources.limitations: Small, non-representative sample; security findings principally concern migrants from four Central American countries.

sources.title: Norma Oficial Mexicana NOM-003-SEDATU-2023: Lineamientos para el fortalecimiento del sistema territorial ante amenazas naturales y cambio climático
sources.organization: Secretaría de Desarrollo Agrario, Territorial y Urbano (SEDATU), Government of Mexico; Diario Oficial de la Federación
geographic_coverage: regional, state, metropolitan and municipal planning scales
sources.temporal_coverage: Published 14 February 2024; applies to preparation or updating of territorial and urban-development plans.
sources.methodology: Official standard sets national multiscale territorial-planning guidelines.
sources.limitations: Normative requirements; the standard does not report implementation or compliance results.

sources.title: New World Bank support to strengthen disaster resilience and protect jobs in the Marshall Islands
sources.temporal_coverage: April 2026 financing approval
sources.methodology: Project announcement and urban exposure diagnosis.
sources.limitations: Project design and intended benefits; implementation and outcomes are not established.

sources.title: Marshall Islands secures major UNDP-GEF investment to protect water, land and atoll communities from climate change
sources.temporal_coverage: December 2025 project preparation approval
sources.methodology: Blue-Green Atolls preparatory announcement.
sources.limitations: Approval initiates detailed preparation, not implementation or final results.

sources.title: Understanding risk is key to growth and jobs in Pacific cities
sources.temporal_coverage: Undated city-risk assessment synopsis
sources.methodology: Staff synthesis of urban risk assessments.
sources.limitations: Qualitative city examples; not exhaustive hazard mapping or causal attribution.

sources.title: Republic of Marshall Islands Climate Security Risk Assessment
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), with IOM and Adelphi under the Climate Security in the Pacific project
sources.temporal_coverage: 2023 assessment drawing on earlier historical evidence and climate projections, including scenarios to 2050 and 2080.
sources.methodology: Climate models, literature review, stakeholder consultations and interviews.
sources.limitations: Living, non-exhaustive assessment; projections carry stated uncertainty.

sources.title: National Adaptation Plan Community Engagement Summary Report: Majuro Atoll
sources.organization: International Organization for Migration (IOM), engaged by the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.temporal_coverage: Majuro NAP consultations conducted October 2022-May 2023; report cover dated 2023.
sources.methodology: Majuro summary of surveys, Day-in-Life activities, focus groups, interviews and community profiles.
sources.limitations: Consultation findings are participant observations, not representative prevalence or causal estimates.

sources.title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Pacific Resilience Project II under the Pacific Resilience Program (P160096)
sources.temporal_coverage: Project implementation status through 28 February 2025, with a World Bank mission update dated 15 April 2025.
sources.methodology: World Bank implementation-status report using project indicators and implementation updates.
sources.limitations: Agency-reported outputs and progress; no independent outcome evaluation was reviewed.

sources.title: Coastal Risk Assesment for Ebeye
sources.organization: Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), World Bank
sources.temporal_coverage: GFDRR technical-report summary published 22 June 2018; assessment tests coastal hazards and climate/sea-level scenarios.
sources.methodology: GFDRR landing-page summary of a coastal hazard and risk assessment.
sources.limitations: The linked 17.8 MB technical-report PDF could not be retrieved; only the opened landing-page summary supports claims.

sources.title: Country Climate and Development Report: Western Balkans 6. North Macedonia Country Compendium
sources.temporal_coverage: October 2024 compendium; municipal vulnerability inputs include 2021 census and 2020 market-access data, with climate and economic projections to 2050.
sources.methodology: CCDR with climate-risk modeling, sector analysis and municipal hazard/vulnerability mapping.
sources.limitations: Municipal inputs are dated; impact modeling has significant uncertainty.

sources.title: North Macedonia Common Country Analysis for the 2021–2025 United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework
sources.organization: United Nations Country Team in North Macedonia
sources.temporal_coverage: CCA issued November 2020; analysis was conducted mainly November 2019–March 2020 and predates full COVID-19 assessment.
sources.methodology: UN country analysis using document review, interviews and participatory risk analysis.
sources.limitations: Mostly pre-COVID-19; dated national assessment, not a current local baseline.

sources.title: The Municipalities of the Republic of North Macedonia take steps to enter the 2030s with greater resilience
sources.organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction, Regional Office for Europe and Central Asia
sources.temporal_coverage: Reports UNDRR cooperation and municipal resilience scorecards conducted in 2024.
sources.methodology: UNDRR report on city cooperation, scorecard workshops and disaster-resilience planning.
sources.limitations: Article summarizes the exercise; it publishes no municipality-level scores or measured outcome changes.

sources.title: *Mali: Climate Resilience and Environmental Governance*
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate through 2023; policy context to 2025
sources.methodology: Literature/data synthesis using a nexus framework; expert review
sources.limitations: Synthesis, not causal evaluation; some climate-conflict wording stronger than underlying evidence warrants. (World Bank) Publisher report explicitly permits non-commercial reproduction with attribution.

sources.title: *Mali Economic Update - Special Chapter: Strengthening Financial Resilience of Pastoralists to Drought*
sources.temporal_coverage: Baseline plus projections to 2050
sources.methodology: Six climate-model/emissions combinations linked to biophysical/economic modelling; drought analysis
sources.limitations: Future precipitation highly uncertain; economic model is scenario-based. (World Bank)

sources.title: *Agence de l’Environnement et du Développement Durable: session du Comité de coordination et suivi de mise en œuvre de la CDN*
sources.methodology: Administrative reporting on NDC coordination
sources.limitations: Describes process and commitments, not independently evaluated implementation outcomes. (Government of Mali)

sources.title: *Climate-related Security Risks and Peacebuilding in Mali*
geographic_coverage: Mali, with emphasis on north/centre and MINUSMA
sources.temporal_coverage: Mainly 2010s-2020
sources.methodology: Qualitative process tracing; literature/UN documents; 57 interviews/correspondence
sources.limitations: Single case/plausibility probe; interview perspectives; written before MINUSMA withdrawal and subsequent conflict changes. (SIPRI)

sources.title: *Is climate exacerbating the root causes of conflict in Mali? A climate security analysis through a structural equation modeling approach*
sources.organization: Frontiers in Climate / Alliance Bioversity-CIAT authors
geographic_coverage: National household sample merged at cercle level
sources.temporal_coverage: Survey/climate/conflict periods used by study
sources.methodology: LSMS-ISA + CHIRPS + ACLED; structural-equation/path mediation
sources.limitations: Observational model; one specified food-production pathway; associations should not be read as proof of event-level causality. (Frontiers)

sources.title: *Mali Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1*
sources.temporal_coverage: Q1 2026 with annual projections
sources.methodology: Cluster/government/UN reporting and UNICEF programme monitoring
sources.limitations: Humanitarian estimates can be revised; UNICEF outputs are not independent impact evaluation. (UNICEF)

sources.title: *Situation report on the crisis in Mali - April 2026*
geographic_coverage: Bamako, Gao, Mopti, Kidal and affected IDP sites
sources.temporal_coverage: April 2026
sources.methodology: Operational monitoring
sources.limitations: Short-period operational source; response counts are outputs, not effectiveness estimates. (United Nations Population Fund)

sources.title: *Humanitarian aid cuts push millions deeper into hunger amid rising violence and population displacement in West and Central Africa*
sources.methodology: Cadre Harmonisé and WFP operational evidence
sources.limitations: WFP is an implementing agency; ration comparison is not presented as a randomized impact evaluation. (World Food Programme)

sources.title: *GIEWS Country Brief: Mali*
sources.methodology: Cadre Harmonisé, production/price monitoring and seasonal forecasts
sources.limitations: Older than 2026 humanitarian sources; seasonal forecasts are prospective and conflict remains a major confounder. (FAOHome)

sources.title: *Impacts of Development Aid to Mali 2008-2021: A Systematic Review of Evaluation Reports - Part I*
sources.organization: Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs, IOB-commissioned research
sources.methodology: 6,296 title/abstract screens; 588 full texts; 104 Mali studies included; methodological quality thresholds
sources.limitations: Evidence ends in 2021; country-level evaluations were included by default without the same quality threshold.

sources.title: *Mali Community Resilience and Inclusive Services Project - Malidenko (P505025), Project Appraisal Document*
sources.temporal_coverage: Project period from 2024
sources.methodology: Project appraisal, institutional and fiduciary design
sources.limitations: Design evidence only: committees, facilitators and grievance systems are intended mechanisms, not proven outcomes. (World Bank)

sources.title: 2025 Resilience Report: Climate, Conflict and Resilience: Pathways to Sustainable and Inclusive Solutions
sources.temporal_coverage: Mali case study in a nine-country FCAS resilience report published in May 2025; field and referenced evidence span different dates.
sources.methodology: Triangulated quantitative data, desk review and key-informant field research across nine case studies.
sources.limitations: Fragile-context data gaps and attribution difficulty limit generalizability; informal coping may be missed.

sources.title: Addressing climate and conflict-related loss and damage in fragile states: a focus on Mali
sources.organization: International Institute for Environment and Development (IIED), with DanChurchAid Mali and TASSAGHT
sources.temporal_coverage: Household research in five Mopti communes; hazard, mobility and loss findings cover differing retrospective periods, including the latest disaster year reported by sampled households.
sources.methodology: Household survey, focus groups and key-informant interviews in five Mopti communes; 408 households, 22 focus groups and four key-informant interviews.
sources.limitations: The displaced-household sample was smaller because access, time and resources constrained recruitment; regression shows association, not causation.

sources.title: Practical solutions at the intersection of climate action, peace, and security in the Liptako-Gourma region
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), West and Central Africa Regional Hub / Liptako-Gourma Stabilization Facility
sources.temporal_coverage: June 2024 study version; released on UNDP portal 16 September 2025; heterogeneous historical case material.
sources.methodology: Literature review, environmental and conflict-data analysis, key-informant interviews, case studies and field observations where possible.
sources.limitations: Conflict restricted engagement; the sample may favor accessible and secure areas; interviews and case studies may be subjective and findings may not generalize beyond the region.

sources.title: Mali, Decentralized evaluation of the Integrated Resilience Package in 20 priority communes (2018–2024)
sources.organization: World Food Programme (WFP), Mali Country Office
sources.temporal_coverage: Evaluation concerns the Integrated Resilience Package implemented from 2018 to 2024; WFP page published 7 January 2026.
sources.methodology: WFP Mali commissioned a qualitative and quantitative evaluation with stakeholder consultations.
sources.limitations: Only the official portal synopsis was accessible; detailed methods, commune names and disaggregated results were not reviewed.

sources.title: Building peace and prosperity through climate action in Mali
sources.temporal_coverage: UNDP programme story published 27 August 2025; examples and testimony are presented as programme and community accounts at that time.
sources.methodology: UNDP programme story with resident testimony and activity descriptions.
sources.limitations: Programme and self-reported examples; not representative or independently evaluated.

sources.title: Myanmar Climate Fact Sheet 2024
sources.organization: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre / Myanmar Red Cross Society
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical to mid-century
sources.methodology: Synthesis of IPCC, World Bank, government and specialist evidence
sources.limitations: Secondary synthesis; several component datasets predate 2024.

sources.title: Myanmar's National Adaptation Programme of Action (NAPA) to Climate Change
geographic_coverage: National plus three PRA townships and seven physiographic regions
sources.temporal_coverage: Baseline 1971-2000; projections to 2100
sources.methodology: PRECIS 20×20 km, A2 scenario; seven stations; PRA/RRA and sector working groups
sources.limitations: Legacy model/scenario; limited station representation; predates current conflict.

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contributions
