sources.temporal_coverage: 2021 onward
sources.methodology: National policy framework and sectoral adaptation priorities
sources.limitations: Policy intentions are not implementation evidence; institutional context changed sharply after 2021.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Myanmar
geographic_coverage: National with Dry Zone, Rakhine, Karenni and border examples
sources.temporal_coverage: Mainly post-2021 to early 2024
sources.methodology: Triangulated conflict, humanitarian, livelihood and climate literature
sources.limitations: Four-page synthesis; causal pathways often rest on secondary evidence.

sources.title: Climate change as an arena of wartime political struggles: Greening of military rule and resistance in Myanmar
sources.organization: Environment and Planning E: Nature and Space
sources.temporal_coverage: Post-2021
sources.methodology: Digital ethnography plus 15 interviews
sources.limitations: Full text restricted in this verification session; abstract and data statement checked.

sources.title: Myanmar September 2024 Typhoon Yagi Floods: Flood Extent Note
sources.temporal_coverage: Sep 2024
sources.methodology: Satellite flood extent, exposure modelling, ground/report corroboration
sources.limitations: Cannot cleanly separate Yagi from concurrent monsoon flooding; exposure ≠ damage.

sources.title: Myanmar Emergency
sources.temporal_coverage: Current through 2026
sources.methodology: WFP needs estimates and operational reporting
sources.limitations: Operational reporting, not an impact evaluation.

sources.title: Country - Myanmar Operational Data Portal
sources.temporal_coverage: Current snapshot
sources.methodology: UN in Myanmar/UNHCR operational displacement estimates
sources.limitations: Dynamic estimates; conflict/access constraints affect enumeration.

sources.title: Cyclone Mocha: Aid efforts severely hampered by new restrictions
sources.temporal_coverage: May-Jul 2023
sources.methodology: MSF field operations and staff observations
sources.limitations: Organization-specific operational perspective; not nationally representative.

sources.title: Mid-term Evaluation of Addressing Climate Change Risks on Water Resources and Food Security in the Dry Zone of Myanmar
sources.temporal_coverage: Project period to Jan 2018
sources.methodology: Evaluation mission, project monitoring, field evidence and ratings
sources.limitations: Pre-coup; project-specific; mid-term rather than terminal.

sources.title: Myanmar's Enduring Polycrisis: Four Years into a Tumultuous Journey
geographic_coverage: National, examples including Rakhine and Chin
sources.methodology: UNDP socioeconomic synthesis
sources.limitations: Publication page verified; 12.4 MB full report was not retrievable in this browsing session, so only page claims are used.

sources.title: Strengthening Food Security in Myanmar: A Roadmap for Localized Action
sources.temporal_coverage: Post-2020 through 2023
sources.methodology: Food-security framework and policy/programme analysis
sources.limitations: Recommendations are intended responses, not demonstrated outcomes; full PDF not parsed in session.

sources.title: Supporting the People of Myanmar
sources.temporal_coverage: 2023-2025 projects
sources.methodology: Project portfolio and reported outputs through third-party implementers
sources.limitations: Beneficiary/output reporting should not be read as evaluated effectiveness.

sources.title: Layers of Deprivation: Multidimensional Poverty in Myanmar
sources.temporal_coverage: People's Pulse Survey 2025; report issued October 2026; shock recall covers the preceding 12 months.
sources.methodology: Nationwide phone survey of 7,463 households; adapted MPI and survey-weighted shock analysis.
sources.limitations: Phone sampling under-represents remote, conflict-affected, stateless and displaced people; shock reports may overlap; associations are not causal.

sources.title: Myanmar: Emergency and Resilience Plan, 2026–2028
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
geographic_coverage: 11 states and regions (not individually named in cited passages)
sources.temporal_coverage: 2026–2028 plan; includes impacts of September 2024 floods and the March 2025 earthquake and describes ongoing FAO field presence.
sources.methodology: FAO strategy drawing on food-security severity analysis, assessments, monitoring and existing field projects.
sources.limitations: Strategic plan, not an independent evaluation; planned activities are commitments, and cited passages provide little named subnational outcome evidence.

sources.title: Myanmar Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026
sources.organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), Myanmar
sources.temporal_coverage: 2026 humanitarian planning period; issued December 2025; draws on 2025 assessments and monitoring.
sources.methodology: Inter-agency plan using multisource needs assessments, partner monitoring and an October 2025 access-severity exercise across 330 townships.
sources.limitations: Planning forecasts are not impact evaluations; data and response reach are constrained by inaccessible areas and reliance on partner reporting.

sources.title: Myanmar Health Cluster Bulletin: August 2026
sources.organization: World Health Organization (WHO) / Myanmar Health Cluster
sources.temporal_coverage: August 2026 disease and flood reporting; health-service figures cover January–June 2026.
sources.methodology: Health Cluster partner reporting on outbreaks, flood impacts and service delivery; 49 partners submitted service data.
sources.limitations: Reporting was incomplete or delayed; medicine and diagnostic shortages constrained response and partner data do not cover all activity.

sources.title: Rakhine State, Western Myanmar: Flood Situation Update No. 1
sources.organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), Myanmar
sources.temporal_coverage: Heavy-rain and flood impacts from early July 2026; partner information compiled through 17 July; report cover dated 20 July.
sources.methodology: OCHA compilation of humanitarian-partner flood, damage, needs and response information at township, village and ward levels.
sources.limitations: Affected-population and damage estimates required continued verification; road, communications and access constraints limited assessment and response.

sources.title: Climate Change Adaptation Plan 2025-2035 with the Action Plan 2025-2027
sources.organization: Ministry of Ecology, Sustainable Development, and Northern Region Development of Montenegro
sources.temporal_coverage: National adaptation plan for 2025-2035; cited observed events and social data are dated in the report, while its risk assessment also discusses projected hazards.
sources.methodology: Plan includes sector vulnerability, gender and capacity assessments.
sources.limitations: Local capacity findings are assessment conclusions.

sources.title: Montenegro National Drought Plan
sources.organization: Ministry of Sustainable Development and Tourism, Government of Montenegro, with UNCCD support
sources.temporal_coverage: Plan dated November 2020; it describes then-current monitoring and drought-management arrangements and summarizes earlier events and proposed actions.
sources.methodology: National working group plan synthesizes sector impacts, drought monitoring, risk assessment and preparedness measures.
sources.limitations: Institutional status and statistics are historical to the 2020 plan; recommendations are not verified implementation.

sources.title: Country Climate and Development Report: Western Balkans 6. Montenegro Country Compendium
sources.temporal_coverage: Country compendium dated October 2024; combines historical event data, institutional assessment and modeled climate-risk scenarios.
sources.methodology: Uses hazard-risk modeling, a Climate Change Institutional Assessment, and social-protection analysis.
sources.limitations: Model results are scenario-dependent; recommendations describe proposed rather than delivered reforms.

sources.title: Common Country Analysis Update 2023: Montenegro
sources.organization: United Nations Country Team in Montenegro
sources.temporal_coverage: Light-touch update; the report states its evidence and data are current as of 30 November 2023 and describes 2022-2023 events.
sources.methodology: UN country analysis update synthesizes national and international data across development priorities.
sources.limitations: Climate observations are historical; the update does not establish a climate-conflict causal relationship.

sources.title: Socio-Economic Impact Assessment of Dzud 2023-2024: Dzud Resilience Strategy Policy Recommendations
sources.organization: UNDP Mongolia, in collaboration with the Government of Mongolia and partner agencies
sources.temporal_coverage: Assesses the 2023-2024 dzud; the PDF cover says September 2024 and the UNDP publication page is dated 27 May 2025. Field survey data were collected in 2024; the risk map cited is dated 20 December 2023.
sources.methodology: Uses NEMA/NAMEM records, field visits and ADAPT household survey.
sources.limitations: Survey covers four aimags; conflict observations are not armed-conflict estimates.

sources.title: 2024 Dzud Early Action and Response Plan
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator's Office and Humanitarian Country Team, Mongolia
sources.temporal_coverage: Plan issued 19 February 2024 for the December 2023-May 2024 dzud response; targeting criteria and actions refer to that event period.
sources.methodology: HCT plan synthesizes government dzud-risk classifications and sector response inputs.
sources.limitations: Plan targets and reported early actions are not a final coverage audit.

sources.title: Mongolia Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4 (Dzud), 30 April 2024
sources.temporal_coverage: Situation report dated 30 April 2024; impact figures cover the November 2023-April 2024 dzud, with programme outputs stated through 25 April 2024.
sources.methodology: UNICEF situation report compiles needs data and agency-reported programme results.
sources.limitations: Snapshot is dated 30 April 2024; output counts are time-bound and not outcome evaluations.

sources.title: World Bank Report Highlights Importance of Social Protection Response in Strengthening Mongolian Households' Resilience to Climate and Economic Shocks
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank press release dated 27 May 2025 summarizing a report on adaptive social protection and herder resilience.
sources.methodology: Publisher summary of a World Bank study of adaptive social protection.
sources.limitations: Full report link did not open; evidence is limited to the official summary.

sources.title: Update of the First NDC of Mozambique (UNFCCC4)
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate 1960-2005; extreme events 1980-2019; projections 2046-2065 and 2080-2100; NDC actions mainly 2020-2025
sources.methodology: National synthesis; historical observations from 32 synoptic stations; seven GCMs; INGD/DeSInventar event data
sources.limitations: Projection excerpt does not identify an emissions/RCP scenario; some underlying studies date from 2009; event records are not attribution studies.

sources.title: Mozambique's National Adaptation Plan (UNFCCC5)
sources.temporal_coverage: Current planning framework drawing on historical evidence and forward adaptation needs
sources.methodology: Extensive consultation; sector/thematic adaptation actions; institutional and capacity assessment; theory of change
sources.limitations: Government planning document, not an independent evaluation; several vulnerability datasets acknowledged as incomplete.

sources.title: Mozambique Country Climate and Development Report (CCDR) (World Bank6)
sources.methodology: Climate-development modelling and economic diagnostic; only publication-page findings used here
sources.limitations: Linked full PDF exceeded crawler access limit; exact claims retained only where the verified publication page provides them.

sources.title: Localised Climate-Related Security Risk Assessment: Mozambique Case Study (GPPAC7)
sources.organization: Global Partnership for the Prevention of Armed Conflict (GPPAC)
sources.temporal_coverage: Data collection Dec 2022-Feb/Mar 2023
sources.methodology: Five focus groups; multistakeholder dialogues; questionnaire to 110 stakeholders; local officials, traditional leaders, communities, climate experts and peacebuilders
sources.limitations: Local perceptions and qualitative synthesis; cannot be generalized nationally; authors explicitly state immediate impact of the assessment was difficult to establish.

sources.title: Mozambique: IPC Acute Food Insecurity Snapshot, Oct 2025-Mar 2026 (IPCinfo8)
sources.temporal_coverage: Oct 2025-Mar 2026, with linked analyses extending to Sep 2026
sources.methodology: Combination of post-shock and post-harvest IPC analyses
sources.limitations: Not designed to isolate causal effects of climate versus conflict/markets; geographic coverage differs between component analyses.

sources.title: Mozambique Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2, February 2026 (UNICEF9)
sources.temporal_coverage: Through 28 Feb 2026
sources.methodology: Operational monitoring drawing on displacement assessments and government/partner reporting
sources.limitations: Humanitarian operational report rather than independent evaluation; programme outputs should not be read as demonstrated long-term outcomes.

sources.title: Humanitarian Action for Children - Mozambique Appeal 2026 (UNICEF10)
sources.temporal_coverage: 2026 planning horizon and 2024-25/2025 evidence
sources.methodology: Humanitarian needs synthesis plus planned targets and programme strategy
sources.limitations: Appeal document; targets and intended mechanisms are not evidence of effectiveness.

sources.title: Inter-Agency Humanitarian Evaluation of the Response to Cyclone Idai in Mozambique (World Food Programme11)
sources.temporal_coverage: 2019 response
sources.methodology: Independent collective-response evaluation; representative survey of affected population plus evaluative evidence
sources.limitations: Publication page fully accessible; linked full evaluation download was not retrievable through the crawler, so only verified publication-page findings are used.

sources.title: Seeds, Cash, and Preparedness: FAO's Anticipatory Actions (FAOHome12)
geographic_coverage: Machanga, Sofala; Maganja da Costa, Zambézia
sources.temporal_coverage: 2024/25 agricultural season
sources.methodology: FAO administrative/programme reporting on anticipatory action
sources.limitations: Self-reported implementation/output evidence; no independent counterfactual or outcome evaluation.

sources.title: Climate Change Adaptation Action and Mainstreaming in Mozambique - Final Evaluation (UNDP IEO Evaluation Resource Center13)
sources.temporal_coverage: Project 2009-2012; evaluation Jan-Feb 2013
sources.methodology: Document/financial review, Maputo mission, stakeholder interviews, primary/secondary evidence
sources.limitations: Old relative to current institutional conditions; evaluator found weak monitoring and inability to cleanly attribute observed mainstreaming results to the project.

sources.title: Leaving No One Behind at Local Level: Cabo Delgado Province Report
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Mozambique; Government of Mozambique
sources.temporal_coverage: Local fieldwork May–June 2023; report published September 2025; climate-shock findings include Cyclone Kenneth (2019) and prior analysis through 2021.
sources.methodology: Review of provincial/district statistics and documents; interviews and survey involving 148 people in Cabo Delgado.
sources.limitations: District selection considered poverty, security and accessibility; findings are not representative of the whole province. Some climate-conflict statements summarize cited prior reports.

sources.title: Mozambique Humanitarian Situation Report No. 12 (End of Year), 31 December 2025
sources.temporal_coverage: Situation and UNICEF response reporting for January–December 2025; report published 9 February 2026.
sources.methodology: UNICEF operational reporting drawing on government, partner, displacement and service-delivery data.
sources.limitations: Operational report, not an independent impact evaluation; needs and partner-reported outputs may be incomplete. Historical 2025 results are not current 2026 conditions.

sources.title: United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework Evaluation: Mozambique (2025), Final Report
sources.organization: United Nations Sustainable Development Group; independent evaluation team
sources.temporal_coverage: Evaluation of 2022–2026 Cooperation Framework; findings mainly cover 2022–2025; field visits and interviews in August–September 2025.
sources.methodology: Independent evaluation using document review, surveys, interviews, focus groups and site visits, with triangulation.
sources.limitations: Fieldwork focused on Maputo, Gaza and Niassa and synthesized some parallel agency evaluations; time, selection, recall and institutional biases remain possible.

sources.title: Comunidades de Cabo Delgado Validam Planos de Acção Espacial
sources.organization: United Nations in Mozambique; Cabo Delgado Provincial Government; UN-Habitat and partners
sources.temporal_coverage: Community planning release dated 26 August 2026; plans and near-term actions described at publication.
sources.methodology: Official UN release describing a participatory territorial-planning process and selected communities.
sources.limitations: Press release reports planned measures and stated tension risks, not an evaluation of implementation or outcomes.

sources.title: Dngrh Reúne Sectores-chave para fazer Balanço da época Chuvosa 2025/2026
sources.organization: Mozambique Ministry of Public Works, Housing and Water Resources (MOPHRH), National Directorate of Water Resources Management
geographic_coverage: Rovuma, Messalo, Montepuez and Megaruma basins
Zambeze, Búzi, Save, Limpopo, Incomáti and Umbelúzi basins
sources.temporal_coverage: Government review of the 2025–2026 rainy and cyclone season; review meeting held 14–15 May 2026; page date not stated.
sources.methodology: Ministry account of a national seasonal review convened by the National Directorate of Water Resources Management.
sources.limitations: Brief official meeting report; no district-level population denominator or climate-change attribution is supplied.

sources.title: Presidente do INGD destaca a importância da antecipação durante o balanço da época chuvosa 2025/2026 em Moçambique
sources.organization: National Institute for Disaster Risk Management and Reduction (INGD), Mozambique
sources.temporal_coverage: INGD review of the 2025–2026 rainy and cyclone season; anticipatory actions reported for December 2025–March 2026; page published 13 August 2026.
sources.methodology: Official summary by the INGD president of seasonal review findings and anticipatory-action results presented to government and partners.
sources.limitations: Aggregated agency-reported results; the release does not disaggregate evacuations or warning reach by named district or establish a counterfactual.

sources.title: Beyond Extractives: Unlocking Mauritania’s Potential for a Sustained, Inclusive and Resilient Growth (Country Growth and Jobs Report 2025)
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed climate and drought impacts since 1950 and 2020-2022; modeled climate impacts to 2050
sources.methodology: Country report combines climate-risk discussion and modeled growth impacts.
sources.limitations: Macroeconomic estimates depend on climate/adaptation scenarios; drought impact is an upper-bound share.

sources.title: Country Climate and Development Report: G5 Sahel
sources.temporal_coverage: Country-specific growth, climate, and poverty scenarios to 2050
sources.methodology: The G5 CCDR models each country separately and links macro projections to household-survey microsimulation.
sources.limitations: Regional framing includes four other countries; distributional modeling does not account for household location or characteristics.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security in Mauritania: Executive Summary
sources.organization: United Nations Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs (DPPA), United Nations Office for West Africa and the Sahel (UNOWAS), and Climate Security Mechanism
sources.temporal_coverage: Study based on literature and country fieldwork in 2023; executive summary published 26 September 2024.
sources.methodology: UN review and 2023 field visit with community, UN and government interviews.
sources.limitations: Executive summary only; pathways remain plausible, geographically broad and unquantified.

sources.title: Analyse du paysage climatique pour les enfants en Mauritanie (Climate Landscape Analysis for Children)
sources.temporal_coverage: Climate and child-vulnerability analysis; report carries UNICEF Mauritania copyright 2024 and includes historical 2022 flood impacts.
sources.methodology: UNICEF synthesis of documents, policies, risk maps and stakeholder/youth input.
sources.limitations: Child climate-risk scores are not FCV measures; conditions may have changed.

sources.title: Mauritania: Refugee Emergency Response (as of 30 June 2024)
sources.organization: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR)
sources.temporal_coverage: Refugee-response snapshot as of 30 June 2024; published 2 August 2024.
sources.methodology: Two-page UNHCR operational response update using registration, arrival-monitoring and needs information.
sources.limitations: Historical operational snapshot; service plans and outputs are not impact evaluations.

sources.title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief: Mauritania
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), Global Information and Early Warning System
sources.temporal_coverage: GIEWS reference date 9 September 2025; includes 2025 lean-season food-security estimates and rainy-season conditions through August.
sources.methodology: FAO GIEWS synthesis of crop, rainfall, food-security and Cadre Harmonisé analysis.
sources.limitations: Seasonal 2025 snapshot, not an update on current 2026 conditions.

sources.title: The Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) of the Republic of Mauritius
sources.organization: Republic of Mauritius; submitted to the UNFCCC
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical and current conditions; projections and policy targets through 2050–2100.
sources.methodology: National NDC synthesizes sector data, projections and stakeholder consultation.
sources.limitations: National aggregates; implementation often conditional on finance, technology and capacity.

sources.title: Annual Report on Performance FY 2024-2025: Ministry of Environment, Solid Waste Management and Climate Change
sources.organization: Government of Mauritius, Environment and Climate Change Division
sources.temporal_coverage: Ministry performance for FY 2024-2025; reports coastal-risk assessment activities through June 2025.
sources.methodology: Ministry performance report summarizes activities and outputs for FY 2024-2025.
sources.limitations: Government self-report; no independent evaluation of risk-reduction outcomes.

sources.title: Coastal Life and Resilience: Diversifying livelihoods and building resilience of coastal communities on Rodrigues Island, Mauritius
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme, GEF Small Grants Programme
sources.temporal_coverage: Community-based adaptation project launched in 2015; story reports activities and outcomes through 2020; page date unstated.
sources.methodology: UNDP story reports a 2015 community-based adaptation project and consultations in Baie du Nord.
sources.limitations: Programme narrative, not an independent impact evaluation.

sources.title: DRR (Floods and Flash Floods)
sources.organization: Government of Mauritius, Observatoire de l'Environnement
sources.temporal_coverage: Reports flood events from 2008 through 2024 and summarizes the Land Drainage Master Plan released in 2025; webpage date unstated.
sources.methodology: Official observatory page summarizes past flood impacts and Land Drainage Master Plan zones and recommendations.
sources.limitations: Summary page, not the plan's technical appendices; it says 16 high-risk sites but enumerates 15 numbered entries.

sources.title: Perception of Climate Change Adaptation in Rodrigues Island
sources.organization: Charles Telfair Centre; author Marie Stéphania Perrine
sources.temporal_coverage: Case-study observations on climate perceptions, livelihoods and adaptation; study period and webpage date are unstated; includes a January-April 2018 example.
sources.methodology: Case study using 110 open-ended questionnaires and 12 snowball-sampled key-informant interviews.
sources.limitations: Convenience respondents and non-probability informants; not a representative survey, and study date is unstated.

sources.title: Why have water shortages in Mauritius sparked the worst civil unrest in recent years?
sources.organization: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)
sources.temporal_coverage: Analyst article reports water-protest events in October 2026 and notes protests in response to water shortages since 2020.
sources.methodology: ACLED analyst narrates protest events and water-cut chronology in October 2026.
sources.limitations: Article does not attribute water cuts to climate change; it names cost-of-living pressures and a police shooting.

sources.title: Malawi's Third Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0)
sources.organization: Government of Malawi, Environmental Affairs Department
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed climate and disaster information and adaptation targets reported in 2026
sources.methodology: Government NDC compiles cited climate information and adaptation targets.
sources.limitations: Impact statistics cite prior studies; adaptation actions are plans, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Climate-Informed Economic Development Key to Malawi's Future Growth and Resilience
sources.temporal_coverage: CCDR headline economic and poverty projections reported in 2022
sources.methodology: World Bank press release summarizes modeled economic, poverty and adaptation findings from Malawi's CCDR.
sources.limitations: The release provides headline estimates but not the model specifications or assumptions behind each estimate.

sources.title: Socio-Economic Effects of El Niño in Malawi: Implications for Recovery and Long-Term Resilience Building
sources.organization: United Nations Malawi and Government of Malawi partners
sources.temporal_coverage: Assessment of the 2023/24 El Niño drought and floods, with outlook material published in 2024.
sources.methodology: UN–government synthesis of crop, education, nutrition and protection sources.
sources.limitations: Secondary synthesis; GBV may be underreported.

sources.title: United Nations Common Country Analysis: Malawi 2024 Update
sources.organization: United Nations Country Team in Malawi
sources.temporal_coverage: Country analysis updated in 2024; mobility and displacement passages include 2022–2024 events.
sources.methodology: UNCT synthesis of national data and consultations.
sources.limitations: Secondary evidence; some estimates lack district detail.

sources.title: State of Malawi Climate in 2024
sources.organization: Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services, Government of Malawi
sources.temporal_coverage: Meteorological observations and reported disaster impacts for calendar year and rainy season 2023/24.
sources.methodology: National weather-station analysis and Department of Disaster Management Affairs incident data.
sources.limitations: Station-based meteorological drought is not the same as agricultural or hydrological drought; disaster counts are reported figures.

sources.title: 2024 UN Country Results Report
sources.organization: United Nations Country Team in Malawi
geographic_coverage: Dzaleka refugee camp and host community
sources.temporal_coverage: Reports on UN Country Framework results and programme outputs during 2024.
sources.methodology: UN agency self-reporting of 2024 programme outputs and results.
sources.limitations: Not an independent impact evaluation; reported outputs do not establish effectiveness. Report publication date is unstated.

sources.title: Malawi Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4, 31 December 2025
sources.temporal_coverage: Operational and needs update for 1 January–31 December 2025; cover dated 26 January 2026.
sources.methodology: UNICEF operational situation report based on programme monitoring and humanitarian response reporting.
sources.limitations: Historical 2025 snapshot; service outputs are not impact evaluations or evidence of current 2026 conditions.

sources.title: Malaysia Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Country climate-development assessment; observed subnational vulnerabilities and policy recommendations, with modeled future impacts.
sources.methodology: Country assessment using sector analysis, biophysical modeling and government and civil-society consultations.
sources.limitations: Recommendations are not evaluated outcomes; district averages mask local variation.

sources.title: Governing Climate Risks as National Security Priority: Call to Re-examine Malaysia’s Reactive Approach to Environmental Hazards
sources.organization: Institute of Strategic & International Studies (ISIS) Malaysia
sources.temporal_coverage: Research note published in 2026; displacement examples from 2021-24 and conditional future risks.
sources.methodology: Research note synthesizes a 2025 conference, roundtable, official data and published studies.
sources.limitations: Qualitative synthesis; conditional pathways are not measured local violence.

sources.title: Balancing Innovation and Coordination: Institutional Solutions for Effective Climate Action in Malaysia’s Borneo States — Subnational Climate Change Institutional Assessment Overview
sources.organization: World Bank Group, with Sarawak Ministry of Energy and Environmental Sustainability and Sabah Forestry Department
sources.temporal_coverage: Institutional overview published March 2026; describes state structures, tools and capacity constraints.
sources.methodology: State assessment based on institutional review and engagement with government agencies.
sources.limitations: Overview covers Sabah and Sarawak state functions, not national adaptation outcomes.

sources.title: Coping with Climate Change: OECD Economic Surveys: Malaysia 2026
sources.organization: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.temporal_coverage: 2026 economic survey chapter; includes first-half 2026 agricultural impacts and current policy status.
sources.methodology: Country economic survey chapter synthesizing official statistics and cited research.
sources.limitations: Some event and projection findings are cited from other institutions.

sources.title: Namibia Systematic Country Diagnostic
sources.temporal_coverage: National diagnostic dated July 2021; household poverty and service indicators chiefly describe 2015/16, alongside drought and climate-risk context through 2018/19.
sources.methodology: Systematic country diagnostic synthesizing poverty, service-access, climate, water and sector evidence.
sources.limitations: Several household and WASH indicators are dated 2015/16; treat them as historical baseline, not current prevalence.

sources.title: Namibia 2022/23 Vulnerability Assessment and Analysis Findings
sources.organization: Namibia Vulnerability Assessment Committee (NAMVAC), Office of the Prime Minister
sources.temporal_coverage: Assessment issued January 2023; covers 2021/22 rainfall and 2022 food-security and nutrition conditions, with a seasonal food-security projection for January–March 2023.
sources.methodology: NAMVAC multi-stage household survey sampled 2,521 households in 209 urban and rural sampling units across all 14 regions, plus secondary data.
sources.limitations: Findings and seasonal projections are time-bound to 2021/22–2023 and are not current 2026 estimates.

sources.title: Namibia Drought Assessment Report 2022
sources.organization: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, with Namibia Red Cross Society
sources.temporal_coverage: 2022 drought assessment drawing on observations and response experience from the 2018/19–2022 drought period, including 2021 population movements.
sources.methodology: IFRC/Red Cross drought assessment with household and qualitative findings from Kunene and Omusati.
sources.limitations: Localized mixed-source assessment; conflict includes human–wildlife/resource tensions, not armed conflict.

sources.title: Namibia Agriculture Disaster Risk Finance and Insurance Diagnostic
geographic_coverage: communal areas north of the Veterinary Cordon Fence
sources.temporal_coverage: World Bank diagnostic copyrighted 2023; institutional and market information includes 2021–2022 observations and proposed future instruments.
sources.methodology: Diagnostic reviews disaster-risk finance, agriculture insurance and smallholder finance, drawing on official data and stakeholder interviews.
sources.limitations: Recommendations are proposals, not delivered outcomes; financial-market and institutional facts are dated to the assessment.

sources.title: 2024/25 Namibia El Niño Induced-Drought Response After-Action Review Report
sources.organization: Government of Namibia, Office of the Prime Minister, with World Food Programme
sources.temporal_coverage: Retrospective review of the 2024/25 national drought response; report cover dated June 2026.
sources.methodology: Participatory review with national/regional agencies, UN, NGOs, civil society, business and community representatives.
sources.limitations: Retrospective national synthesis with limited site-level detail.

sources.title: Contribution Déterminée au Niveau National révisée
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate; projections to ~2030/2050; policy 2021-2030
sources.methodology: National synthesis; CMIP5 ensemble of 29 models for cited projections; RCP4.5/RCP8.5
sources.limitations: Projection generation is now dated; some impact statistics originate in older national reports.

sources.title: Niger's Adaptation Communication (UNFCCC)
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical programmes 2006-2019 plus contemporary priorities
sources.methodology: National synthesis of adaptation policies, programmes, gaps and support needs
sources.limitations: Government self-assessment; project listings do not establish outcomes.

sources.title: CPF FY26-FY31, Annex 5: Streamlined Country Diagnostic
sources.temporal_coverage: Mainly 2022-2026 context plus historical evidence
sources.methodology: Synthesis of socioeconomic, FCV, climate, institutional and sector evidence
sources.limitations: Diagnostic synthesis, not a causal climate-security study; some estimates rely on earlier WB work.

sources.title: Niger - Emergency and Resilience (FAOHome)
sources.methodology: FAO emergency assessment and programme data
sources.limitations: Operational synthesis; headline counts may update; programme plans are not evaluations.

sources.title: GIEWS Country Brief: Republic of the Niger (FAOHome)
geographic_coverage: Niger; Tillabéri, Diffa, Tahoua and other named regions
sources.methodology: Crop monitoring, cereal balance, prices, earth observation and Cadre Harmonisé evidence
sources.limitations: Short early-warning product; projected CH figures subject to later updates.

sources.title: Acute Malnutrition Situation Aug.-Nov. 2025 and Projections to July 2026 (IPCinfo)
sources.methodology: IPC classification and multi-factor driver analysis
sources.limitations: Projection periods are not observations; nutrition causation is multifactorial.

sources.title: Niger Operation Factsheet, January-June 2025 (UNHCR Data Portal)
sources.temporal_coverage: Jan.-Jun. 2025
sources.methodology: UNHCR operational reporting
sources.limitations: Publication page accessible; PDF binary did not render in browser. Reported contributions are not independently evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Climate Change and Violent Conflict in West Africa: Assessing the Evidence (SIPRI)
sources.temporal_coverage: Literature available to 2022
sources.methodology: Systematic review of academic climate-conflict evidence
sources.limitations: Regional and explicitly finds a limited research base.

sources.title: Niger Country Strategy and Programme Evaluation (ioe.ifad.org)
sources.temporal_coverage: IFAD portfolio 2011-2020
sources.methodology: Independent country strategy/programme evaluation
sources.limitations: Covers IFAD, not Niger's entire adaptation portfolio; period ends 2020.

sources.title: Climate Change and Conflict in Pastoralist Regions of Ethiopia, Kenya and Niger
geographic_coverage: Niger and Burkina Faso; Niger field sites incl. Tahoua/Tillabéri
sources.temporal_coverage: Evidence collected mainly before 2014
sources.methodology: Climate/livelihood synthesis with interviews, focus groups, institutional evidence and climate analyses
sources.limitations: Foundational but old; some statistics and institutional conditions are obsolete; local findings cannot be generalized.

sources.title: Niger Humanitarian Situation Report No. 3 (End-of-Year), 31 December 2025
sources.temporal_coverage: Humanitarian conditions and UNICEF-supported responses during 1 January–31 December 2025; report dated 8 February 2026.
sources.methodology: UNICEF 2025 operational and needs monitoring.
sources.limitations: Not independent outcome evaluation.

sources.title: *Federal Republic of Nigeria Adaptation Communication to the UNFCCC* (UNFCCC5)
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical; policy status to 2021; projections to 2090s
sources.methodology: Government synthesis of climate evidence, vulnerability, policy, institutions and adaptation actions
sources.limitations: Some climate projections and underlying studies are older; several programme entries are descriptions rather than evaluations.

sources.title: *Climate Change and Violent Conflict in West Africa: Assessing the Evidence* (SIPRI2)
sources.temporal_coverage: Literature available through 2021
sources.methodology: Systematic review organized around climate-conflict pathways
sources.limitations: Regional synthesis; Nigeria evidence is concentrated on pastoral mobility, Middle Belt conflict and Lake Chad. Authors themselves describe the academic evidence base as limited.

sources.title: *Implementation Completion Report Review: Erosion & Watershed Management Project (P124905)* (World Bank7)
sources.temporal_coverage: Project 2012-2022
sources.methodology: IEG review of project design, implementation, M&E and completion evidence
sources.limitations: The review says the critical vulnerability-reduction outcome was inadequately measured and the 2022 impact-evaluation results were not reported.

sources.title: *Conflict and shrinking humanitarian assistance drives northern Nigeria hunger crisis...* (World Food Programme8)
geographic_coverage: Nine conflict-affected northern states; detailed Borno/NE evidence
sources.methodology: Cadre Harmonisé results plus WFP operational/access evidence
sources.limitations: Humanitarian source; its statements on recruitment/exploitation include reported observations and risk interpretations, not causal impact evaluation.

sources.title: *Nigeria: Acute Malnutrition Situation... Oct 2025-Sep 2026* (IPCinfo9)
geographic_coverage: 204 LGAs in Northeast, Northwest, North Central
sources.temporal_coverage: Oct 2025-Sep 2026
sources.methodology: IPC acute-malnutrition analysis and projections
sources.limitations: Not national coverage; should not be generalized to southern Nigeria.

sources.title: *Nigeria - Forcibly Displaced Populations*
sources.temporal_coverage: Snapshot 1 Mar 2025
sources.methodology: UNHCR/IOM DTM/NIS/NCFRMI displacement data
sources.limitations: One-page snapshot; causal categories are broad and differ by region.

sources.title: NEMA DG speech on disaster-risk financing, including 2024 EOC flood dashboard (NEMA11)
sources.temporal_coverage: 2024 floods; 2025 statement
sources.methodology: NEMA Emergency Operations Centre incident-dashboard totals
sources.limitations: Dashboard methodology and definitions are not described on the page. No climate-change attribution is made.

sources.title: *Maiduguri flood update* (NEMA12)
sources.temporal_coverage: Sep 2024
sources.methodology: NEMA field/response reporting
sources.limitations: Local event only; no climate attribution analysis.

sources.title: *NEMA Conducts Flood Impact Assessment in Surulere Communities, Lagos State* (NEMA13)
sources.temporal_coverage: Jul 2026
sources.methodology: NEMA field assessment
sources.limitations: Highly local; rainfall was one of several reported causal factors.

sources.title: *NEMA Commences Review of National Disaster Management Framework and Response Plan...* (NEMA14)
sources.methodology: Official description of framework-review process
sources.limitations: Records an institutional process and intended improvements, not evaluated performance.

sources.title: *DG NEMA Attends AATF Meeting as Vice President Directs Activation of Early Action Platform for Flood Response* (NEMA15)
sources.temporal_coverage: 2026 flood season
sources.methodology: Official account of anticipatory-action activation and funding
sources.limitations: Intended mechanism/output only; no evidence yet of avoided losses or improved outcomes.

sources.title: Nigeria Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2, 30 June 2025
sources.temporal_coverage: Humanitarian needs and response for 1 January–30 June 2025; report published 30 July 2025.
sources.methodology: UNICEF mid-year needs and programme-monitoring report.
sources.limitations: Operational reporting; no independent impact evaluation.

sources.title: Nicaragua to receive emergency funding following devastation left by Eta and Iota
sources.temporal_coverage: 2020 hurricane impacts and 2021 response design.
sources.methodology: Project approval announcement with local vulnerability context.
sources.limitations: Plans are not completed results; no attribution of either storm to climate change.

sources.title: Nicaragua, climate resilience of rural households in the Dry Corridor: final evaluation
sources.temporal_coverage: Evaluation summary for the 2020-2025 project.
sources.methodology: Publisher's substantive summary of an evaluation.
sources.limitations: Full report not inspected; summary calls for continued support and only partial institutionalization.

sources.title: Nicaragua country overview
sources.temporal_coverage: Undated operational overview accessed26October 2026.
sources.methodology: Operational country summary; Spanish text inspected.
sources.limitations: Rolling page; no dated causal estimates or nationally representative subnational rates extracted.

sources.title: 2025 Annual Report, Chapter IV.B: Nicaragua
sources.temporal_coverage: Country conditions and cited events through 2025; climate impacts include El Niño conditions in 2024.
sources.methodology: IACHR Nicaragua chapter; full PDF inspected.
sources.limitations: Synthesis cites WFP/FAO/WMO; Dry Corridor only, without municipalities or event attribution.

sources.title: Violencia contra pueblos indígenas y afrodescendientes de la Costa Caribe en Nicaragua
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical violence and institutional developments through 2024; report approved 25 August 2025.
sources.methodology: Original 133-page Spanish IACHR thematic report inspected in full.
sources.limitations: The report documents rights and violence, not climate-event impacts; its climate connection concerns radio coverage of local environmental and climate issues.

sources.title: Nicaragua realizó el lanzamiento del Sistema Nacional de Respuesta a Emergencia de Nicaragua (SINAREM)
sources.organization: Sistema Nacional para la Prevención, Mitigación y Atención de Desastres (SINAPRED)
sources.temporal_coverage: SINAREM launch and design announcement, February 2025.
sources.methodology: Full official SINAPRED announcement page opened.
sources.limitations: Government announcement describes intended functions and launch, not operational reach or independently evaluated effectiveness.

sources.title: Nicaragua country strategic plan (2024–2029), Revision 02
sources.temporal_coverage: Strategic plan for 2024–2029; Revision 02 approved September 2026.
sources.methodology: WFP publisher page and its substantive plan and outcome summary inspected.
sources.limitations: The linked plan PDF returned an anti-robot challenge; page summary records commitments, not delivered outcomes, and gives no local target areas.

sources.title: Climate Risks, Exposure, Vulnerability and Resilience in Nepal
sources.temporal_coverage: Assessment published in 2023; combines current risk mapping and mid-century climate projections.
sources.methodology: Spatial hazard maps combined with socioeconomic vulnerability indicators and CMIP6 projections.
sources.limitations: Household coping and shock outcomes are only partly captured; results are modeled.

sources.title: Second Nationally Determined Contribution
sources.organization: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Forests and Environment
sources.temporal_coverage: NDC covering 2021-2030.
sources.methodology: Government submission setting out national climate vulnerability context and adaptation priorities.
sources.limitations: The NDC is a policy statement and planned response, not an evaluation of implementation outcomes.

sources.title: Synopsis of Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
sources.organization: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Forests and Environment
sources.temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 synopsis setting out priorities through 2035.
sources.methodology: Four-page government synopsis of climate commitments, adaptation priorities, and estimated investment needs.
sources.limitations: Brief synopsis rather than a full technical assessment; proposed investment needs and plans are not achieved results.

sources.title: Enhancing Human Security through Local Climate Actions: Situational Assessment of Nalgad Municipality and Barekot Rural Municipality, Jajarkot District, Karnali Province, Nepal
sources.temporal_coverage: Municipal baseline assessment reported in the PDF; publication date is not stated on the report cover.
sources.methodology: Household baseline survey (824 households), consultations and assessment of municipal frameworks.
sources.limitations: Two municipalities only; not a national estimate or armed-conflict analysis.

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0
sources.temporal_coverage: NDC period to 2035; loss-and-damage discussion includes 2024 events.
sources.methodology: Government NDC submission with a national loss-and-damage account and cited event-attribution findings.
sources.limitations: The submission does not identify its event-attribution study here; impacts are not district-disaggregated.

sources.title: Nepal: 2024 Floods Response Plan, Humanitarian Needs and Priorities
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator and Nepal Humanitarian Country Team
sources.temporal_coverage: September 2024 floods and landslides; response plan for October–December 2024.
sources.methodology: Joint Humanitarian Country Team plan using NDRRMA reporting and initial rapid assessments.
sources.limitations: The plan says full damage estimates were still under government assessment; no independent evaluation.

sources.title: Nepal Floods and Landslides of September 2024: Updates 1 and 2
sources.temporal_coverage: UNDP operational updates dated 15 November 2024 and 5 January 2025 after the September floods and landslides.
sources.methodology: UNDP operational reporting on deployments and recovery activities.
sources.limitations: Self-reported outputs and ongoing activities; no independent outcome assessment.

sources.title: Nauru Climate Impact, Vulnerability and Risk Assessment: Synthesis Report
sources.organization: Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO), prepared for SPREP and the Government of Nauru
sources.temporal_coverage: 2025 synthesis of four climate hazard, vulnerability, exposure and risk assessments, with recent conditions and projections to 2050 and beyond.
sources.methodology: CSIRO synthesis compiles four technical climate hazard, vulnerability, exposure and risk assessments prepared for Nauru’s adaptation-planning project.
sources.limitations: The synthesis reports data and confidence limits; district-level social vulnerability is less detailed than physical exposure.

sources.title: Republic of Nauru Framework for Climate Change Adaptation and Disaster Risk Reduction II (RONAdapt II)
sources.organization: Government of the Republic of Nauru, Department of Climate Change and National Resilience
sources.temporal_coverage: Government framework dated 2025, based on the 2024 review and consultation process; includes current assessments and planned adaptation actions.
sources.methodology: Government framework combines sector risk studies and 2024 consultations.
sources.limitations: Activities are plans, not evaluated outcomes.

sources.title: Republic of Nauru Updated Nationally Determined Contribution
sources.organization: Government of the Republic of Nauru
sources.temporal_coverage: Updated contribution covers 1 January 2021 through 31 December 2030 and sets out conditional and unconditional intended actions.
sources.methodology: National climate contribution organized around sustainable-development priorities and cross-sector policy actions.
sources.limitations: Commitments and targets do not establish that projects were completed or outcomes achieved.

sources.title: PACC Nauru: Adapting water resource management to increase climate-resiliency and protect against future climate change risks
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), with Government of Nauru, SPREP, GEF and Australian Government
sources.temporal_coverage: Project page reports completed status but gives no publication or implementation dates in the opened text.
sources.methodology: Official UNDP project summary page describing project aims, context and listed results and outputs.
sources.limitations: Page is not a project evaluation and provides no measured water-security impact estimates.

sources.title: Pakistan: Updated Nationally Determined Contributions 2021
sources.organization: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Climate Change
sources.temporal_coverage: National climate vulnerability and adaptation planning in the 2021 NDC, with projections through the 2050s.
sources.methodology: Government NDC with climate-impact, socioeconomic, and adaptation chapters.
sources.limitations: National synthesis; projection uncertainties vary across cited analyses.

sources.title: Pakistan Floods 2022: Post-Disaster Needs Assessment Main Report
sources.organization: Government of Pakistan, with Asian Development Bank, European Union, United Nations Development Programme, and World Bank support
sources.temporal_coverage: Assessment of the June–August 2022 floods; data collected September to mid-October 2022.
sources.methodology: Government-led PDNA triangulating agency and remote-sensing inputs during September–October 2022.
sources.limitations: Rapid assessment during an ongoing disaster; inaccessible areas limit accuracy.

sources.title: Balochistan Climate Change Policy
sources.organization: Government of Balochistan and UNDP Pakistan
sources.temporal_coverage: Provincial climate risks and 2022 flood/fire impacts discussed in a 2024 policy.
sources.methodology: Provincial policy developed with consultations across districts and sectoral planning.
sources.limitations: Policy synthesis, not an independent impact evaluation; recommendations are not evaluated capacity.

sources.title: Health Emergency Situation Report: Monsoon Floods, 25 July 2025
sources.organization: World Health Organization, Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean
sources.temporal_coverage: Monsoon and flash-flood impacts and health response reported as of 25 July 2025.
sources.methodology: Operational snapshot drawing on NDMA totals, PMD forecasts and health-sector reporting.
sources.limitations: Single-date situation update; early impact and response figures are not final outcome estimates.

sources.title: Pakistan: Acute Food Insecurity Analysis, December 2025–September 2026
sources.organization: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) Analysis Unit, Pakistan
sources.temporal_coverage: Analysis covers observed acute food insecurity in December 2025–March 2026; its April–September 2026 projection period had elapsed by this extraction.
sources.methodology: Current-period classification used a household Food Security and Livelihood Assessment from September–November 2025 and secondary sources.
sources.limitations: 45 districts were covered, fewer than the previous 68; this finding is historical.

sources.title: Adaptación y Resiliencia
sources.organization: Dirección de Cambio Climático, Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá
sources.temporal_coverage: Official page describing local adaptation projects and climate-adaptation water programming; project dates are not consistently stated.
sources.methodology: Official page text read; it summarizes ministry projects and objectives.
sources.limitations: Undated page mixes completed activities with expected outputs; no impact evaluation.

sources.title: Programa de Adaptación al Cambio Climático a través del Manejo Integrado de los Recursos Hídricos presenta resultados impactantes en cuencas priorizadas
sources.organization: Dirección de Cambio Climático, Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá
sources.temporal_coverage: Programme results published in June 2023.
sources.methodology: MiAmbiente summary of two watershed projects.
sources.limitations: Implementer-reported; no evaluation or basin-specific beneficiary split.

sources.title: Panama: National Case Study
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical drought record and social/service indicators with vintages mainly from 2013 and 2021–2023.
sources.methodology: FAO drought-portal country profile presents selected hazard pathways and social, economic and infrastructure indicators.
sources.limitations: Underlying datasets and methods are not detailed on this profile; indicator years differ and are not current estimates.

sources.title: Agua y el Canal
sources.temporal_coverage: Live water-management page with 2023 drought facts and planning information current at October 2026 access.
sources.methodology: Canal Authority page describes water operations, service areas and water-project planning.
sources.limitations: Institutional account, not independent assessment; dated facts and live-page material are distinguished.

sources.title: Parlamentarios británicos visitan la comunidad de Gardi Sugdub en la comarca Guna Yala
sources.temporal_coverage: Official account of a January 2024 visit and then-planned relocation to Isberyala.
sources.methodology: Ministry press account of a site visit and discussion with Guna Congress participants and Sáhilas.
sources.limitations: Dated event report, not a household survey or follow-up on completion, consent or service delivery.

sources.title: Fenómeno de El Niño – SINAPROC
sources.organization: Sistema Nacional de Protección Civil, Panamá
sources.temporal_coverage: 2026 El Niño alert, emergency declaration and July–December 2026 outlook as stated on the live page.
sources.methodology: Civil-protection page summarizes official meteorological and hydrological monitoring and response arrangements.
sources.limitations: Forecast lacks model/scenario details; response descriptions are not evaluation results.

sources.title: Peru Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical indicators through 2019; climate and development projections to 2050 and 2100
sources.methodology: World Bank synthesis of climate, socioeconomic and institutional diagnostics with referenced quantitative estimates.
sources.limitations: Dated 2022 with mixed indicator vintages; a national development report, not a conflict study, and attribution varies by estimate.

sources.title: Peru: Strategic Actions Toward Water Security
sources.temporal_coverage: Diagnostic studies conducted 2019–2021; model projections for 2030 and 2050
sources.methodology: Water-security diagnostic using local hydrological data, satellite evapotranspiration, demand databases and SENAMHI climate projections.
sources.limitations: Mixed study vintages and model assumptions; basin deficits are not 2026 measurements, and conflict discussion does not establish climate attribution.

sources.title: Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas y Peligros Asociados 2025–2027
sources.organization: Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros (PCM), with CENEPRED
geographic_coverage: Peru; district risk scenarios and multisector interventions
sources.temporal_coverage: Plan period 2025–2027; susceptibility analysis draws on historical El Niño/La Niña episodes and records through April 2024
sources.methodology: Government risk plan combines hazard susceptibility, district exposure and vulnerability with agency intervention targets.
sources.limitations: ENSO-based risk scenario is not an event forecast or anthropogenic attribution; intervention targets are not verified delivery outcomes.

sources.title: Informe N.º 12-2025-OGASA: Conflictos socioambientales, diciembre 2025
sources.organization: Ministerio del Ambiente (MINAM), Oficina General de Asuntos Socio-Ambientales (OGASA)
geographic_coverage: Peru; named socio-environmental cases in Puno and other regions
sources.temporal_coverage: December 2025 monthly monitoring; annual alert totals through December 2025
sources.methodology: Official monthly administrative monitoring of socio-environmental cases, alerts and agency commitments.
sources.limitations: Agency case and commitment records are not independent verification, climate attribution or impact evaluation.

sources.title: Follow the Water: Emerging Issues of Climate Change and Conflict in Peru
sources.organization: Foundation for Environmental Security and Sustainability (FESS), prepared for USAID Office of Conflict Management and Mitigation
geographic_coverage: Santa River Basin and Huaraz, Ancash
sources.temporal_coverage: Field research in 2011–2012; published June 2012
sources.methodology: Original field interviews in Lima, Huaraz/Santa River Basin and highland Arequipa.
sources.limitations: 2012 discussion paper expressly not official USAID; qualitative interviews, no causal evaluation.

sources.title: Climate Risk Country Profile: Philippines
sources.organization: World Bank Group; Asian Development Bank
sources.temporal_coverage: Observed climatology through 2020; projections through 2080–2099; social vulnerability evidence includes earlier cited studies.
sources.methodology: World Bank–ADB country profile compiles climate datasets, referenced literature, observed climatology and CMIP5/KNMI projections.
sources.limitations: National synthesis; underlying social studies are dated. Global models cannot resolve many smaller islands, and precipitation projections are uncertain.

sources.title: DA, partners complete climate risk vulnerability assessment of BARMM provinces; recommend CRA options to guide investments, interventions
sources.organization: Philippines Department of Agriculture, Climate Resilient Agriculture Office
geographic_coverage: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao
sources.temporal_coverage: Six-province CRVA completed in March 2024; projected crop suitability under RCP8.5, with projection period not stated on the webpage.
sources.methodology: DA CRAO's six-province CRVA used geospatial and secondary data validated by local offices.
sources.limitations: Only the official summary was inspected; underlying reports, datasets and projection horizons were unavailable.

sources.title: Understanding Climate, Conflict, and Environmental Impacts in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM): Workshop Report
sources.organization: Harvard Humanitarian Initiative; Mindanao State University–Iligan Institute of Technology
geographic_coverage: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao
sources.temporal_coverage: Two-day workshop held 30–31 May 2023; case accounts describe historical and then-current conditions without consistent event dates.
sources.methodology: Two-day 2023 workshop; 70 actors invited, 29 organizations attended in person.
sources.limitations: Qualitative workshop accounts; local residents, Indigenous groups and other vulnerable people were absent; no causal testing.

sources.title: Philippines 2026 Joint Workplan: Summary Document
geographic_coverage: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao
sources.temporal_coverage: Reports selected 2025 context and sets out 2026 activities under the 2024–2028 cooperation framework.
sources.methodology: UN 2026 workplan summarizes 2025 context, planned support and programme status.
sources.limitations: Self-reported or planned activity, not outcome evaluation or climate-conflict evidence.

sources.title: Philippines Country Climate and Development Report
sources.temporal_coverage: Official landing-page summary includes projection to 2040; report publication date not stated on the page.
sources.methodology: World Bank landing summary describes prior-work synthesis, partial-equilibrium sector analyses and CGE modeling.
sources.limitations: Landing page only; full report unavailable, so model assumptions and local estimates were not inspected.

sources.title: Republic of Palau Second National Communication to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
sources.temporal_coverage: Palau climate vulnerability assessments and historic conditions reported in 2013; includes projections to 2050 and 2100.
sources.methodology: Melekeok climate assessment in a government UNFCCC communication, using field surveys and GIS.
sources.limitations: Dated site study; proposed actions are not completed adaptation.

sources.title: Palau Water Policy 2025–2045
sources.temporal_coverage: Water-sector conditions and policy priorities in the 2025–2045 policy; includes historical 2016 drought and cited climate projections.
sources.methodology: Government water policy synthesizing watershed and utility information.
sources.limitations: Some climate projections date to the 2015 policy.

sources.title: Disaster Risk and Climate Change Impact Survey in the Republic of Palau, Phase I
sources.organization: Palau Bureau of Cultural and Historical Preservation and University of Oregon researchers; supported by UNDP through the EDCR project
sources.temporal_coverage: Field survey conducted November 2019 and March 2020; includes flooding observed at Kayangel in April 2021.
sources.methodology: Targeted ten-site cultural survey using field observations and standardized condition forms.
sources.limitations: Selected heritage sites are not representative of Palau communities.

sources.title: Palau’s Rock Islands Southern Lagoon launches resilience strategy
sources.temporal_coverage: Resilience strategy launched in 2023; coastal fisheries management plan adopted in 2021.
sources.methodology: UNESCO publisher report on the locally developed Rock Islands Southern Lagoon resilience strategy.
sources.limitations: Short programme account; reports strategy activities and institutional arrangements, not independent impact estimates.

sources.title: Palau: Office of Climate Change — climate impacts and the Palau Climate Change Policy 2025
sources.organization: Office of Climate Change, Republic of Palau
sources.temporal_coverage: Official page summarizing the 2025 climate policy and climate projections through 2040 and later.
sources.methodology: Official climate-office page summarizing policy pillars and selected climate impacts and projections.
sources.limitations: Underlying projection methods and emissions scenario are not provided on the page; policy pillars are commitments, not delivered results.

sources.title: Enhancing disaster and climate resilience in Palau
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme, Pacific Office
sources.temporal_coverage: Reports damage from Typhoon Haiyan in 2013 and El Niño drought in 2016; describes disaster-capacity activities in February 2020.
sources.methodology: UNDP report on disaster impacts, preparedness partnership and planned post-disaster assessment training.
sources.limitations: Historical programme account; training was scheduled, and reported losses are not a climate-attribution or conflict assessment.

sources.title: Climate, Peace and Security Assessment: Papua New Guinea
sources.organization: adelphi research / Weathering Risk, with Asian Development Bank and United Nations Development Programme
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical and current conditions with SSP projections through 2100.
sources.methodology: Mixed-method climate-security assessment combining literature, climate-risk analysis, interviews, workshops, expert interpretation, and regional case studies.
sources.limitations: The synthesis does not causally identify most pathways; some findings are locality-specific and projection uncertainty remains. Explicit reuse terms: CC BY-ND 4.0.

sources.title: Papua New Guinea's Enhanced Nationally Determined Contribution 2020
sources.organization: Government of Papua New Guinea and Climate Change and Development Authority
sources.temporal_coverage: Policy targets and information needs mainly through 2030.
sources.methodology: Government policy submission presenting sector baselines, consultations, quantified adaptation targets, and stated information gaps.
sources.limitations: Targets are intended commitments rather than evaluated implementation; the document predates later policy and hazard developments. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Papua New Guinea: Technical Assistance Report - Climate Policy Diagnostic
sources.temporal_coverage: Diagnostic mission in July 2024 and policy status through publication.
sources.methodology: A fiscal and institutional diagnostic based on desk review, a government mission, consultations, and sector analysis.
sources.limitations: Not an FCV study; historical climate series have gaps and recommendations are not implementation outcomes. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review. The technical-assistance notice restricts disclosure beyond enumerated recipients absent consent; public download alone does not establish an open reuse licence.

sources.title: Assessing the Evidence: Migration, Environment and Climate Change in Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: Migration and displacement evidence available through 2014.
sources.methodology: A literature review supplemented by six key-informant interviews and technical working-group feedback.
sources.limitations: Older and largely secondary evidence; volcanic, development, and climate-related mobility drivers must remain distinct. The copyright notice reserves all rights and requires prior written permission for reproduction.

sources.title: Beyond Barriers: Papua New Guinea Case Study
sources.organization: Humanitarian Advisory Group and World Vision / Australian Humanitarian Partnership
geographic_coverage: Four communities and relevant provincial and national institutions
sources.temporal_coverage: Field evidence around 2021-2022.
sources.methodology: Review of more than 20 documents, eight interviews, 12 focus groups, and 167 community participants.
sources.limitations: A four-community qualitative sample cannot represent all provinces or customary settings and is not an outcome evaluation. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Implementation Completion Report Review: Rural Service Delivery and Local Governance (P126157)
geographic_coverage: Eight pilot local-level governments in two provinces
sources.temporal_coverage: Project implementation and inspection shortly after closure.
sources.methodology: Independent review of completion evidence, performance indicators, project records, and reported site inspections.
sources.limitations: Project-specific and geographically narrow; weak monitoring and short follow-up constrain attribution and sustainability assessment. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Evaluation of the UNDP Papua New Guinea Country Programme 2018-2022
sources.temporal_coverage: UNDP country programme from 2018 through 2022.
sources.methodology: Independent evaluation using document review, interviews, field visits, triangulation, and OECD-DAC-oriented criteria.
sources.limitations: Limited interviews and field provinces; some climate-policy products were incomplete or too recent for outcome assessment. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Food Assistance to El Nino Affected Populations in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Affected local-level governments in Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: 2015-2016 El Nino drought and frost episode.
sources.methodology: Operational assessment drawing on mobile vulnerability analysis and mapping with the National Disaster Centre.
sources.limitations: Implementing-agency evidence, not an independent or nationally representative evaluation; findings apply to assessed affected areas.

sources.title: Common Country Analysis 2024 Update
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator's Office in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Papua New Guinea, with subnational examples
sources.temporal_coverage: Conditions and UN analysis available through 2024.
sources.methodology: A UN country-team desk synthesis incorporating country evidence and expert inputs.
sources.limitations: Secondary expert synthesis rather than causal analysis; national aggregation obscures provincial and ecological differences. No explicit reuse licence was established in the 26 October 2026 source review.

sources.title: Taking Locally Led Climate and Security Actions Seriously in Papua New Guinea
geographic_coverage: Papua New Guinea, with selected local and provincial inquiry
sources.temporal_coverage: Contemporary conditions through 2025.
sources.methodology: Desk review, interviews, participatory workshop, and locally led climate-security analysis.
sources.limitations: Limited province-specific coverage; parts of government and private-sector perspectives were underrepresented. Explicit reuse terms: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

sources.title: Disaster Displacement: Papua New Guinea Country Briefing
sources.organization: Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre and Asian Development Bank
sources.temporal_coverage: Event data through 2021 with prospective risk modelling and a local survey.
sources.methodology: Disaster-displacement database, probabilistic modelling, and survey of 150 displaced and 152 non-displaced people.
sources.limitations: Likely under-recording and one non-representative local survey; geological and climatic hazards require separate treatment. Explicit reuse terms: CC BY 3.0 IGO.

sources.title: 2024 UN Annual Results Report: Papua New Guinea
sources.organization: United Nations Country Team, Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: Reported programme achievements and ongoing/planned activities during 2024.
sources.methodology: UN Country Team annual results reporting for the 2024 Cooperation Framework.
sources.limitations: Self-reported programme outputs; longer-term outcomes were not evaluated.

sources.title: United Nations Highlands Joint Programme (Phase 2)
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme, Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: Phase 2 is stated to run January 2026–April 2028.
sources.methodology: Official UNDP project summary, outcomes and partner information.
sources.limitations: Programme aims and expected outcomes are not independently evaluated results; page gives no publication date.

sources.title: Flooding in Western Province Post-Disaster Needs Assessment Report: Papua New Guinea, April to July 2024
sources.organization: Government of Papua New Guinea, National Disaster Centre, and United Nations Development Programme
sources.temporal_coverage: Prolonged flooding and assessed impacts from April through July 2024.
sources.methodology: Official publication summary describes a joint post-disaster assessment of 60 villages and one care centre.
sources.limitations: Only the directly opened official summary was inspected; the 33-page report download was inaccessible in this review.

sources.title: Raporty klimatyczne dla Polski (Climate reports for Poland)
sources.organization: Institute of Meteorology and Water Management – National Research Institute (IMGW-PIB)
sources.temporal_coverage: National observations for 2025 compared with the 1991–2020 normal.
sources.methodology: Official IMGW-PIB report-entry summary reports national station-network measurements for 2025 against the 1991–2020 normal.
sources.limitations: The linked report PDF was inaccessible; only the publisher summary was read, so no regional breakdown or detailed methods are claimed.

sources.title: Zmiana klimatu w Polsce. Fakty, liczby, skutki
sources.organization: Ministry of Climate and Environment of Poland
sources.temporal_coverage: Temperature trend since 1951; March 2026 conditions; water-availability and European drought statistics reported for recent years including 2025.
sources.methodology: Ministry explainer synthesizes climate statistics and consequences, citing IMGW, IOŚ-PIB and Copernicus.
sources.limitations: The page does not reproduce measurement uncertainty, full methods or regional disaggregation for every statistic.

sources.title: Susza w Wielkopolsce. Partnerstwo regionalne
sources.organization: Ministry of Climate and Environment of Poland
sources.temporal_coverage: Regional water-balance trends described since the beginning of the 21st century; partnership letter signed 2 April 2026; projects reported as in implementation.
sources.methodology: Ministry page summarizes regional drought assessment, partnership and projects.
sources.limitations: No underlying hydrological data or project evaluation is presented.

sources.title: Urban Overheating & Adaptation Measures: An Analysis at EU, National, and Local Level
sources.temporal_coverage: Polish city adaptation-project implementation and reported measures mainly cover 2001–2019; report published in 2024.
sources.methodology: World Bank review includes national policies and Polish city adaptation cases.
sources.limitations: Not an impact evaluation; underlying municipal plans were not inspected.

sources.title: Prime Minister: We will spare no expense rebuilding flooded areas
sources.organization: Chancellery of the Prime Minister of Poland
geographic_coverage: flood-affected settlements under a state of natural disaster
sources.temporal_coverage: Preliminary flood-impact and evacuation figures presented at a government briefing on 21 September 2024.
sources.methodology: Chancellery statement summarizes preliminary reports supplied by regional governors at the 21 September 2024 crisis meeting.
sources.limitations: Figures were provisional; standing water prevented complete inspection, and the statement gives no final loss assessment.

sources.title: Wsparcie samorządów w działaniach na rzecz adaptacji do zmiany klimatu
sources.organization: Ministry of Climate and Environment of Poland
sources.temporal_coverage: Eastern Poland municipal support project under the 2021–2027 EU programme; city adaptation plans due by 2 January 2028.
sources.methodology: Ministry page outlines the Eastern Poland adaptation project.
sources.limitations: No independent project evaluation is provided.

sources.title: Paraguay: Historical Drought
sources.organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
sources.temporal_coverage: National drought history and vulnerability indicators through 2023; the page cites severe droughts from 1960–2022.
sources.methodology: FAO's national drought case-study page was read in full; it summarizes drought impacts and selected national indicators.
sources.limitations: Undated page synthesizes cited material with mixed vintages; indicators are not all locality-specific.

sources.title: Country Climate and Development Report: Paraguay
sources.temporal_coverage: Report published 2024; combines historical observations, cited statistics, modeled projections, and policy diagnostics.
sources.methodology: Full 90-page World Bank CCDR inspected.
sources.limitations: Historical, cited and modeled material have varying vintages; local sample detail is limited.

sources.title: Desafíos del sector agua, saneamiento e higiene ante el cambio climático de Paraguay
sources.organization: UNICEF Paraguay and Dirección de Agua Potable y Saneamiento (DAPSAN-MOPC)
sources.temporal_coverage: Published November 2024; reports WASH coverage and a climate-risk assessment informed by consultations and earlier policy and climate material.
sources.methodology: Full UNICEF/DAPSAN report; combines policy and climate review, WASH analysis and workshops.
sources.limitations: Some indicators and projections are earlier-source material; conflicts lack case detail.

sources.title: Indigenous Climate Action Plan and Disaster Risk Reduction
sources.organization: Federation for the Self-Determination of Indigenous Peoples (FAPI)
sources.temporal_coverage: Indigenous plan validated by FAPI member associations on 2020-10-16 and published in November 2020; includes community accounts and proposed actions.
sources.methodology: Full English translation of FAPI Indigenous plan inspected.
sources.limitations: Qualitative member accounts are not representative; proposals are not implementation evidence.

sources.title: *West Bank and Gaza Country Climate and Development Report*
geographic_coverage: West Bank and Gaza with city/subregional analysis
sources.temporal_coverage: Historical climate through 2020; projections to 2055/2090; socioeconomic evidence mainly pre-2023
sources.methodology: CMIP6/SSP projections, sector modelling, World Bank socioeconomic and institutional analysis
sources.limitations: Predates the October 2023 conflict and subsequent transformation of Gaza; some sector estimates are model-based. PDF p.2 permits noncommercial reproduction with attribution, subject to any further third-party permissions; not an unrestricted CC licence.

sources.title: *The State of Palestine’s First Nationally Determined Contributions - Updated Submission*
sources.temporal_coverage: Planning horizon primarily 2021-2040
sources.methodology: National policy process; sector implementation action plans; costing and institutional arrangements
sources.limitations: Policy commitments and targets, not independently demonstrated outcomes; predates post-2023 destruction.

sources.title: *Conflict and social vulnerability to climate change: lessons from Gaza*
sources.organization: Mason, Zeitoun & el Sheikh; *Climate and Development*
geographic_coverage: Gaza Strip; stakeholder evidence centred on Gaza City
sources.temporal_coverage: Consultations Dec 2008-Aug 2009
